title: PR Manager DE
description:
A fight lasts minutes. A great story travels much further.

The comeback nobody saw coming. The rivalry that divides an arena. The person behind the fighter, with a story that deserves to reach people who have never watched MMA.

At OKTAGON, those stories are everywhere.

We’re building a sports brand with international ambitions, passionate fans and events that bring thousands of people together. Germany is a major part of that journey. And we’re looking for a PR Manager who knows how to make our stories matter to German media.

Someone who can earn the trust of a sports editor, spot an angle for a business title and understand why a digital format might reach an audience a traditional press release never will.

You’ll help decide which stories we tell, who we tell them to and how far they go.

Your stories need to travel beyond the cage.

Sports media will be your home ground. But your curiosity should take you further.

A fighter’s journey can belong in a mainstream interview. Our growth can start a business conversation. Training, personality and culture can open doors to fitness and lifestyle coverage.

You’ll find those opportunities and turn them into pitches that give each outlet a reason to care.

Here’s what you’ll take ownership of:

  • Build real relationships with German media. Develop and maintain a network across sports, digital and mainstream outlets. Get to know the journalists, their audiences and the stories they actually want.

  • Earn coverage for OKTAGON, our events and our fighters. Create opportunities around upcoming fights and recognise stories that deserve attention outside the event calendar.

  • Find new routes to our audience. Follow how the media landscape is changing, from digital publishers and podcasts to emerging editorial format

title: Security & Privacy Lead
description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As Scarlet's first Security & Privacy Lead, you will own how we protect the information our customers trust us with. They share highly sensitive data with us, and keeping it safe is one of our most important responsibilities. Scarlet is growing fast, and our security and privacy programme has to keep up the pace.

You will own our ISO 27001-certified information security management system and our data privacy programme, and make them scale as we grow. You will work closely with engineering to find and fix risks early, and with teammates across Scarlet so that everyone, from new joiners to contractors, has a secure environment that works for them.

You will also shape how Scarlet adopts AI tools safely, assessing the threat vectors of new tools and helping build an internal ecosystem of AI tools that is secure by design.

As a certification body, we hold ourselves to high standards for information security and data privacy. Your work will help us meet them without slowing anyone down.

description:
We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

title: Marketing Manager - Benelux
description:
Location: London, with regular time in Benelux

Finance Deserves Better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We’re looking for a Benelux Marketing Manager to make Light the default finance platform for scaling companies across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. You’ll be grounded in our London GTM hub and spend lots of time in the region, getting to know the market up close.

Concevoir et tester une solution d’automatisation

The mission of Neural Concept’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is to help our customers solve their most complex engineering challenges. We collaborate closely with engineering and design teams within the automotive, aerospace and energy industries, understand their challenges and pains, and help them identify solutions to accelerate their conception processes. description:
We're building the AI operating system for vets. Our AI agent Emma already runs client communication for clinics in 7 countries, including the largest veterinary groups in the world. With our pre-seed just closed, we're expanding into new products and new markets at the same time. As Chief of Staff, you'll own our expansion into new countries end to end.

There are more pets than ever, and fewer vets to care for them. Clinics are short on staff, vets spend half their day on admin, and their suicide rate is six times higher than average. title: Customer Service and Logisitcs Manager
description: Customer Service & Logistics Manager    Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.  We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food, we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.  Everything we do is about  Making Better Happen™.    AAK Locations   This position is based in Zaandijk, the Netherlands, with responsibility across our Zaandijk and Rotterdam operations. Leading the Customer Service and Logistics teams across Zaandijk and Rotterdam, you will have the opportunity to influence both the day-to-day operation and drive how we develop our ways of working for the future.  This is a broad leadership role where people, customers and operational excellence come together. You will own the end-to-end order-to-delivery process, covering Customer Service, transportation of bulk liquids and packed goods, external warehousing, inventory performance and logistics costs.  You will work closely with Commercial, Planning, Operations, Procurement and Quality, giving you significant exposure across the business. At the same time, as part of AAK’s European Customer Service & Logistics network, you will have the opportunity to exchange best practices and help turn continuous improvement, standardization and digitalization into action beyond the Netherlands.  If you enjoy leading people, rolling up your sleeves to solve real operational challenges and turning improvement opportunities into results, this is a role where you can make a visible impact on our customers, our teams and our business. Take ownership of the end-to-end order-to-delivery process, ensuring reliable execution, proactive customer communication and high service levels. Loopt een case uit de hand, dan stap je in. Je weet wat er speelt omdat je er middenin zit.     De kern van je rol is je team. Het zoekt een team lead die het uitdaagt, coacht, aanspreekt als het nodig is en voordoet hoe goed klantcontact eruitziet. Jij zorgt dat elke klant snel, vriendelijk en deskundig geholpen wordt, of het nu gaat om een snackbar, een sportclub, een festival of een stadion. Je zorgt er ook voor dat je team daar zelf trots op is.     Je rapporteert aan de Head of Customer Operations. Je werkt nauw samen met Onboarding, Technical Operations en Enterprise Operations, zodat de klant één naadloze klantreis ervaart. Geen overdrachtsmomenten, geen “daar ga ik niet over”.      Wat je gaat doen:     Het team dagelijks aansturen:  je regelt planning, prioriteiten en bezetting, en je zorgt dat het ook op piekmomenten (wedstrijddag, festivalweekend) klopt.   Zelf meedraaien in de operatie:  je pakt complexe of escalerende klantcases op en springt bij waar het nodig is. Zo houd je voeling met de klant en met het werk van je team.   Mensen laten groeien:  je voert regelmatig gesprekken, geeft eerlijke feedback en maakt persoonlijke ontwikkeldoelen met je teamleden. Trends en knelpunten signaleren  en ze vertalen naar betere processen, kennis en werkwijzen.   Kennisdeling borgen:  je zorgt voor een actuele kennisbank en duidelijke werkafspraken, zodat niet alles in jouw hoofd zit. Rapporteren  over teamprestaties, klanttevredenheid en verbeterpunten aan de Head of Customer Operations. title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Ben jij sterk in relatiemanagement, neem je graag de regie en krijg je energie van het verbeteren van dienstverlening? Als Service Delivery Manager bij ARP zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten kunnen rekenen op kwalitatieve, betrouwbare en efficiënte IT-dienstverlening. Je bewaakt de gemaakte afspraken, stuurt op prestaties en rendement en zorgt ervoor dat onze dienstverlening blijft aansluiten op de behoeften van de klant én de doelstellingen van ARP.  In deze rol ben je de verbindende schakel tussen onze klanten, interne teams en externe partners. Je bouwt aan duurzame klantrelaties, hebt oog voor zowel de klantbeleving als de commerciële kant van onze dienstverlening en signaleert waar kansen en verbeteringen liggen. Je wacht niet tot een klant een probleem aankaart, maar herkent ontwikkelingen en risico's tijdig en neemt initiatief om hierop in te spelen.  Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor jouw klantenportefeuille en de verdere ontwikkeling van de dienstverlening. Je weet de juiste mensen in beweging te krijgen, houdt overzicht over complexe vraagstukken en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken worden nagekomen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse operatie en draag je actief bij aan het verbeteren en professionaliseren van onze serviceorganisatie.   Jouw job      Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en prestaties van onze dienstverlening aan de hand van SLA's, KPI's en gemaakte afspraken. Je herkent trends, signaleert risico's vroegtijdig en neemt initiatief om afwijkingen te voorkomen en de dienstverlening structureel te verbeteren.   Je beheert een eigen klantenportefeuille en bouwt aan langdurige, constructieve klantrelaties. Je begrijpt de behoeften en verwachtingen van klanten en weet deze te vertalen naar passende dienstverlening.   Je hebt oog voor de balans tussen klanttevredenheid, kwaliteit en rendement. Je signaleert afwijkingen in de dienstverlening, herkent meerwerk en commerciële kansen en stemt hierover af met Sales en andere betrokken stakeholders.   Je adviseert klanten over onze dienstverlening, signaleert verbetermogelijkheden en stelt concrete Service Improvement Plans op. Je denkt mee over oplossingen die zowel de klantbeleving als de efficiëntie en kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening verbeteren.   Bij complexe klantvraagstukken en escalaties neem je de regie over de klantgerichte opvolging. Je zorgt voor duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden, bewaakt gemaakte afspraken en houdt de klant proactief geïnformeerd. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met de operationeel verantwoordelijke teams.   Je analyseert resultaten, KPI's, contractafspraken en klantfeedback en rapporteert over de prestaties van de dienstverlening. Je vertaalt inzichten naar concrete acties en signaleert tijdig kansen, risico's en verbetermogelijkheden.   Je denkt mee over de servicestrategie, initieert verbeteringen in processen en procedures en draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering van onze dienstverlening en serviceorganisatie.      J

title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
description:

Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.

As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About Liftoff Security Team

The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools. As our Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you will own internal offensive testing and lead the move from point-in-time penetration tests to continuous, AI-assisted testing. You will independently plan assessments, safely validate vulnerabilities, work with engineering teams through remediation and retesting, and build sustained knowledge of our source code and systems. You will contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security, support Accelerate and MX as priorities change, and share the team's on-call and incident-response work.

Responsibilities

  • Independently plan and execute internal penetration tests across applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems; prioritize assessments by risk and business impact.
  • Define testing scope and rules of engagement with system owners, assess production risk, and choose safe methods for validating vulnerabilities.
  • Combine hands-on testing with source-code review and architectural analysis to find vulnerabilities and demonstrate realistic attack paths.
  • Partner with engineering teams to explain findings, agree on practical fixes, track remediation, and retest to confirm the risk is resolved.
  • Maintain knowledge of Liftoff’s systems and attack surface, revisit high-risk attack paths as systems change, and turn confirmed findings into repeatable tests.
  • Build testing tools and workflows that combine hands-on assessments with ongoing automated testing and remediation validation.
  • Make security testing self-service where practical through reusable tests, documented assessment and retesting workflows, and clear remediation guidance.
  • Support the annual third-party penetration test for independent validation and customer and audit

title: Trading Manager
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including

Using flight proven satellite buses and Loft designed payload hub infrastructure, you will lead the development activities of the missions you are in charge of.

  • Accommodate customer missions on Loft’s rideshare programs, contributing to satellite-level bud

title: ML Runtime Engineer
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours.
The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast.

As our ML Runtime Engineer, you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon.

About this role:
  • Own model compilation: turn partner ONNX models into optimized engines per accelerator (TensorRT, Hailo, AMD/ROCm), within power & thermal budgets
  • Build the ground-side compile & delivery path; define how a mismatched engine is detected/rejected on-node
  • Build performance tooling: benchmarking, profiling, operator-coverage matrices, and budget validation

title: Customer Delivery Engineer
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
 
Customer Delivery Engineers (CDEs) own the end-to-end deployment and execution of customer satellite missions at Loft. We serve as the primary technical interface to our customers and translate mission objectives into operational reality, from early requirements and ConOps development through commissioning, on-orbit operations, and continuous improvement.

Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Sleutel jij graag aan techniek die blijft bewegen? Als Liftmonteur in onze werkplaats zorg jij ervoor dat bouwliften in topconditie blijven. Met jouw technische kennis los je storingen op en maak je iedere lift klaar voor gebruik.

Jouw baan als Liftmonteur op de werkplaats bij RECO

Als Liftmonteur op de werkplaats van de afdeling Verticaal Transport bij RECO zorg jij dat onze bouwliften altijd veilig draaien en klaarstaan voor de volgende klus. Jij sleutelt aan personen- en goederenliften, loopt ze volledig na en zorgt dat storingen snel opgelost worden. Of het nou mechanisch of elektrisch is: jij zoekt het probleem op en vindt de passende oplossing. Ook bij grotere of ingewikkelde storingen draai jij je hand niet om voor een goede oplossing.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

✅ Onderhouden, inspecteren en gereedmaken van bouwliften in onze werkplaats.
✅ Opsporen en verhelpen van mechanische en elektrische storingen.

✅ Zelfstandig complexe storingen uitlezen, analyseren en verhelpen;
✅ Werken vanuit de werkplaats en waar nodig afstemmen met collega-monteurs om samen tot de beste oplossing te komen.

Requirements

👍 Je bent 32 - 40 uur per week beschikbaar van 7-16 uur;👍 Werkervaring hebt op het gebied van mechatronisch en bij voorkeur ook elektrotechniek;

👍 Je bent een echte doener, neemt initiatief, probleemoplossend vermogen én kunt goed samenwerken.

title: Grondwerker Bouwplaatsinrichting
description:
Job Description

Jij steekt graag je handen uit de mouwen en zorgt dat alles onder de grond én op de bouwplaats goed geregeld is — samen maken we het werk klaar.

Jouw baan als Grondwerker bij RECO

Als Grondwerker Bouwplaatsinrichting bij RECO werk je elke dag buiten op verschillende bouwplaatsen in Nederland. Samen met collega’s zorg je ervoor dat alles wat nodig is op en rond de bouwplaats goed wordt voorbereid en aangelegd.

Je doet graafwerk, legt voorzieningen aan en helpt mee bij technische werkzaamheden. Je werkt vaak samen in een duo en bent bezig met praktisch werk waar je aan het einde van de dag duidelijk resultaat van ziet.

Geen dag is hetzelfde: de ene keer sta je op een nieuw project, de andere keer werk je verder waar je gisteren bent begonnen.

Kort gezegd: jij maakt de bouwplaats klaar zodat anderen veilig en goed hun werk kunnen doen.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

✅ Graaf- en grondwerk uitvoeren;

✅ Helpen bij het aanleggen van bouwplaats voorzieningen;

✅Ondersteunen bij elektrotechnisch en ander technisch werk;

✅Samenwerken met collega’s op verschillende locaties;

✅Zorgen dat het werk veilig en netjes gebeurt.

Requirements

Wat breng jij mee?

👍 Je bent fulltime (40 uur) beschikbaar

👍 Je bent fysiek fit en werkt graag buiten

👍 Je hebt een BE-rijbewijs (of bent bereid dit te halen)

👍 Je denkt praktisch en werkt graag met je handen

Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met:

✅ Een goed salaris;

✅ 28 vakantiedagen per jaar, oplopend tot 31 dagen als waardering voor geen ziekteverzuim;

✅ Overwerkvergoeding;

✅ Buitendienstvergoeding;

✅ Een collectieve zorgverzekering én goede pensioenregeling met maar 3,3% eigen bijdrage, de rest betaalt RECO;

✅ Veel opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkhed

Jouw baan als Liftmonteur bij RECO

Als Liftmonteur in de buitendienst bij RECO werk je op de meest uiteenlopende bouwprojecten door heel Nederland. Samen met ervaren collega's monteer en demonteer je tijdelijke personen- en goederenliften, voer je onderhoud uit en zorg je ervoor dat onze liften veilig en betrouwbaar functioneren. title: Product Engineer, Shop
description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

title: Process Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About Rohlik Group

Rohlik Group is Europe's leading online grocery delivery service. Using technology, we deliver a weekly shop of 25,000 SKUs in under three hours, in 15-minute delivery slots — giving our customers back their time, freedom and flexibility.

We believe the world needs a better food system: more sustainable, more inclusive, and bringing healthier, more personalised food to everyone. In every city we operate, we handpick the best and freshest local produce — from butchers to bakeries — and work directly with farmers through our Farm-to-Door program, alongside the trusted brands and affordable own-label products our customers love.

About the Team

The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.

The Role

As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network — from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Your projects will span both hardware (robotics, automated material handling, conveyor and packing systems) and software (control logic and orchestration optimisation), using whichever combination best solves the problem.

 

What We Offer

  • Unlimited Vacation: Unlimited vacation days for a balanced work-life balance

  • Tax-Free Benefits: Monthly vouchers of €45 tax-free (via become.1)

title: Support Engineer, PAYGO
description:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Thousands of developers and companies use Exa on pay-as-you-go. As the Support Engineer for PAYGO, you own all of their inbound questions: getting started, search quality, billing, errors, integrations, and real bugs. The volume is high and every day is different.

It's one of the fastest ways to learn Exa end to end. You'll work with our AI support tools, the docs, Product and Engineering, and you'll see what developers build with Exa before anyone else does. Some of the people writing in are tomorrow's biggest customers, and you'll be the one who spots them.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the PAYGO queue: answer what the AI first line can't, quickly and clearly

  • Debug with customers: reproduce issues with the API, read their code and send working fixes

  • Triage well: production issues and unhappy customers first, everything else in order

title: Praktikant (m/w/d) – Produktentwicklung & Datenaufbereitung
description:
CERTUSS beschäftigt über 150 Mitarbeitende in Deutschland, Großbritannien und den USA und ist mit seinen Dampferzeugern in mehr als 90 Branchen weltweit vertreten. As a Working Student, you will be a key part of our Product Management Team to work on the entire product life cycle that includes first idea, development, go-to-market and continuous support. You’ll push boundaries of unmanned ground vehicle technologies together with the UGV Product Manager.

title: UX/UI Designer (m/f/d)
description:
About the role:

As a UX/UI Designer, you will shape intuitive and user-centered experiences for complex digital products within the Quantum Systems ecosystem.

You will work at the intersection of users, product, and engineering, translating complex workflows and technical requirements into clear, efficient, and visually compelling interfaces.

From early user flows and wireframes to interactive prototypes and polished UI designs, you will take ownership of the design process and collaborate closely with Product Managers and Software Engineers to turn ideas and requirements into solutions that work in real-world environments.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design intuitive and efficient user experiences for complex web applications, platforms, and technical systems.

  • Translate complex user workflows, product requirements, and technical constraints into clear and accessible UX concepts.

  • Create user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs using Figma.

  • Design data-heavy and operational interfaces such as dashboards, maps, monitoring views, configuration screens, and control applications.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the entire product-development lifecycle.

  • Contribute to and continuously improve our design system, ensuring consistency, scalability, and usability across our products.

  • Participate in design reviews and actively incorporate feedback into iterative design improvements.

title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
description:
Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances.

We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.

We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them.

  • Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud.

  • Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems.

  • Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles.

  • Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards.

  • Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field.

  • Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team.

title: Lead Homologation Engineer (m/w/d) – EU-Typgenehmigung

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Fahrzeug von Anfang an homologationsfähig entwickelt wird – und führst die Genehmigung anschließend selbst durch. Keine Zuarbeit, keine Schnittstellenpflege. Du bist die Person, die am Ende den Weg zur Zulassung frei gemacht hat.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients.

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs, while most German hospitals already operate at a loss.

We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash. Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital, until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe.

Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin. Join us!

Why this role matters

Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand.

That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish: from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team.

Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer – Microsoft Fabric & Power BI (m/w/d)
description:
Du baust lieber Datenplattformen, denen das Management vertraut, als Dashboards, die nach drei Wochen keiner mehr öffnet? Du sprichst SQL, Python und DAX genauso fließend wie die Sprache des Controllings? Dann lass uns reden.

Wir suchen genau dich, wenn du Datenprojekte von der Quelle bis zum Management-Dashboard verantwortest. Nicht nur Pipelines, nicht nur Reports, sondern das Ganze, mit sauberem Datenmodell in der Mitte.

Pexon Consulting baut Cloud- und KI-Plattformen für große Unternehmen und den gehobenen Mittelstand im DACH-Raum. Seit 2020 haben wir über 400 Projekte umgesetzt, für mehr als 100 Kunden. Wir sind Partner von AWS, Microsoft Azure und Google Cloud und nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Unser Versprechen: Bankqualität und KI auf Kubernetes.

Du arbeitest in unserem Bereich Data & AI mit Schwerpunkt Analytics. Du baust für unsere Kunden Lakehouse- und Warehouse-Lösungen auf Microsoft Fabric und SQL Server und machst daraus Reporting, mit dem Fachbereich und Geschäftsführung wirklich steuern.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Plattformen bauen: Du konzipierst und baust Lakehouse- und Warehouse-Architekturen in Microsoft Fabric, mit OneLake, Data Factory und Notebooks.

  • Daten modellieren: Du entwirfst Star-Schemas, baust ETL/ELT-Pipelines und sorgst dafür, dass die Datenqualität stimmt.

  • Reporting, das genutzt wird: Du entwickelst Power-BI-Reports und semantische Modelle mit DAX, Power Query und Row-Level Security.

  • Datenbanken im Griff: Du integrierst und optimierst SQL Server, Azure SQL und PostgreSQL.

  • Nah am Fachbereich: Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, definierst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden KPIs und Reports und übergibst die Lösung sauber an den Kunden.

  • Als Senior oder Lead: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen und, je nach Erfahrung, für fachliche Führung im Projekt.

Landwirten zu helfen, ihre Betriebe wirtschaftlich erfolgreich und zukunftssicher zu führen.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is har

Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. title: Product Operations Manager
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About us
At Legora, we’re changing how lawyers work. Our AI-native platform helps legal teams research, review, draft, and collaborate. We build closely with our clients and ship quickly across a growing number of markets.

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Platform team

description: Marketing | Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Reports to the CEO    Compensation: $90,000 to $120,000 CAD base salary    Silvie is building the Oura for seniors and health.   Silvie helps older adults live safer, longer and better in their own homes, and gives their families peace of mind. No cameras. Nothing to wear. Silvie is the consumer brand of Pontosense, whose technology is live in 24 countries, and it launches nationally in January.   Our launch goal isn't volume. It's fans.    Why now   January brings families to Silvie. Lifecycle is what keeps them, and turns them into the people who tell their friends. The everyday habit: weekly digests and in-app moments that make Silvie part of the family routine.  Referral that feels like a recommendation: turn happy families into the next ones, through Founding Families and referral programs.  Retention and win-back: spot quiet homes early and bring them back with something useful, not a discount.  Segments that matter: the buyer and the parent, direct, agency and carrier families, each with the right message.  Testing and measurement: A/B test journeys, timing and copy, with clear dashboards for activation, retention, referral and churn.  Time with real families: listen in on support calls and read the replies, so every journey is built on what families actually say.     What Makes This Hard     Two audiences: the adult child who buys, and the parent who decides whether Silvie stays.  Trust first: privacy and dignity come before any campaign.  Calm, never fear: the tone has to reassure, especially around the moments that matter most.  A launch on the calendar: core journeys need to be live as families arrive.     What Success Looks Like    First 90 days     Welcome, onboarding and referral journeys are live and measured.  You have baseline activation and retention numbers the whole team understands.  You have tested your first big ideas and shipped what worked.     6 to 12 months     More homes are set up and active in their first month.  Retention is up and churn keeps going down, month over month.  Referral is a real channel, not a side project.  Families reply to our emails because they want to.     T

  • Write Python scripts and configure integrations as needed for customer engagements.

title: Senior Partner, Germany
description:
About the Role

A legal technology company is seeking a Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled law practice in Germany. You will bring an established client practice, continue advising clients, and help move recurring legal work onto AI-powered workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Help shape the firm's growth and contribute to its path toward Series A.

  • Transition your portable client practice to the firm's platform while continuing to serve those clients.

  • Build market credibility and develop opportunities through your private equity, venture capital, and mid-market network.

  • Identify cross-selling opportunities for commercial and compliance services across your client base.

  • Work with the founding team to automate recurring legal matters using AI agents.

What We're Looking For

  • 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level.

  • German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

title: Assistant Financial Controller
description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing and mentorship. We maintain a culture of ownership, and we value engineers who are curious about the business and keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and the customer experience.

title: Project Engineer (Data Centres & Industrials)
description:
About the role

Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for data centres and large industrials. We're looking for a Project Electrical Engineer to be the electrical owner on first-of-a-kind power projects - private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, MV and HV grid connections.

This is a technical role with a unique expanded scope to broader infrastructure project management. Early on you are the project manager: you hold the programme, the development budget and the external parties, from concept design through connection offer to design freeze and financial close. From there you stay on as the electrical owner through construction, commissioning and energisation, with a delivery team around you.


What you'll do
  • Own the programme and the development budget. Schedule from early concept to design freeze - siting, connection application, planning, consents, procurement, long-lead items - worked back from the customer's energisation date. Appoint and manage consultants, ICPs and study providers. Surface risk early and clearly communicate them to the stakeholders.
  • Own the electrical concept through to sign-off. Single-line diagrams, general arrangements, switchgear and plant layouts, cable routes, metering and comms architecture. Direct and interrogate the studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, earthing, power quality). Chair design reviews and stage gates, and take options to the Project Lead and customer with a recommendation.
  • Lead the grid interface. DNO, TO and NESO - applications and offers, technical requirements, securities and milestones, contestable and non-contestable scope, ICP/IDNO coordination, MPAN registration.
  • Budget ownership through completion. Credible capex inputs for the project

title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer
description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle.

You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch.

The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together.

Responsibilities

Functional and system testing

  • Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing.

Role
Someone has to prove that our AURA RF gridded ion thruster does its job. As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you run the test programme that turns designs into verified, flight-ready hardware, using NewOrbit’s own vacuum facilities.

You start with testing: you build the rigs, run the campaigns, find what fails and give the evidence that drives the next design. As the programme matures, your role grows into design ownership, calculating, designing and building the thruster yourself, and testing your own designs. Your results decide what flies.

Responsibilities

Test and verify

  • Plan and own the propulsion test campaigns that support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries.

  • Operate the vacuum system, RF generators, high-voltage supplies, gas feed and thrust balance during electric propulsion tests.

  • Run plasma diagnostics and data acquisition, then analyse the results.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise.
You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem.
This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you.
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.

Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

title: KYC Quality & Governance Manager, Mukto Pay
description: Company Introduction  NEO PSP Limited runs Mukto Pay, a wallet licensed by Bangladesh Bank and owned by Banglalink (VEON Group). Our Vision is: Digital money for every Bangladeshi, every day, on any phone.   Job Description   The role: builds and leads Know Your Customer (KYC) checks after onboarding for customers and merchants - hands-on, automating, growing a team with volume.     Build and lead the team: a small in-house core plus contract reviewers hired through an outsourcing company; size it on volume, set targets, shifts and quality checks; hold the vendor to a service-level agreement; no one reviews their own work.    Customer KYC after activation: check electronic KYC (eKYC) files against the national ID (NID) record, manual overrides, borderline face matches, special cases.    Merchant KYC: own, and at first do, the KYC of merchants, agents and distributors - documents, trade license, outlet, photos, screening, risk level.    Automate: own the automation plan with the technology team - every repeated check becomes a rule or a tool (flags from the NID check, face match and document reading, screening alerts, a case workflow); people handle the exceptions.    Re-check, fix and escalate: re-check high-risk files every year and whenever details change; log every failed file with an owner and a due date; a second person re-checks each fix; suspicious, forged and high-risk cases go to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Compliance the same day.    Improve and report: remove the causes of errors with the onboarding teams; monthly dashboard (files checked, pass and fail, error types, ageing, cost per file); evidence for audits and Bangladesh Bank.     Academic Qualification     Bachelor's degree; CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist) is a plus.      Job Experience Required      5+ years in KYC operations or KYC quality control at a mobile financial services (MFS) provider, bank, payment provider or telecom operator in Bangladesh.    Has led a team with contract or outsourced staff and managed the vendor.    Has automated manual checks (rules, scripts, workflow tools, SQL, Power BI).    Has checked digital and paper files, merchants included; spots forged documents.    Knows the Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit (BFIU) e-KYC Guidelines and the Money Laundering Prevention Act.      Required Capabilities      Builder: improves the process, not only runs it; fixes causes, not just files.    Hands-on, automation first: does the work, then makes the system do it.    Leader: hires, sets targets, coaches, holds a vendor to standard.    Firm and clear: fair calls under pressure; English and Bangla; discreet with data.

description:
Headquarters:  United States
      URL:   https://www.caretalkhealth.com 
 

  Job Title: Patient Support Specialist   - Remote  
  Location:  Remote - United States 
  Employment Type:  FT W2 
  Compensation:  $20 per hour 
 
  CareTalk Health  
  CareTalk Health is a fully remote, nationwide virtual medical practice. We partner with Medicare Advantage plans to deliver Annual Wellness Visits and close care gaps, reaching members wherever they are. We believe virtual care isn't a compromise — it's care delivered the way patients actually want it. Our job is to make that experience simple, reliable, and human.  
  About the Role  
 We are seeking Patient Support Specialists (PSS) who are the first point of contact for patients in our virtual clinic and play a critical role in ensuring smooth, timely, and high-quality care delivery. The PSS is the starting point of the virtual care experience. They contact scheduled patients, confirm readiness for the visit, and seamlessly coordinate the handoff to the care team. By ensuring smooth patient flow, the PSS plays a critical role in maintaining patient satisfaction, keeping the clinical schedule on track, and delivering an exceptional virtual care experience. 
 We are hiring for multiple full-time positions. All opportunities are fully remote. The hours are Monday-Friday 9-6pm EST, compensated at a rate of $20 per hour.  
 
  What You’ll Do   
  Key Responsibilities  
  Care Team Coordination   
 
 Serve as the central coordinator for multiple care teams at once, ensuring patients are connected with the right clinician at the right time. 
 Drive patient engagement by keeping the flow of visits moving smoothly across several concurrent schedules. 
 Transfer patients to the appropriate care team members using call handling tools and provide real-time intake information. 
 Notify the RN when a patient is ready, track the status of each visit, and anticipate next steps to prevent delays. 
 Monitor call activity across teams and proactively support timely handoffs from RN to provider. 
 Escalate scheduling conflicts, clinical concerns, or patient-related issues promptly to protect care quality and efficiency. 
 
  Patient Intake and Check-In   
 
 Initiate outbound calls to scheduled patients to confirm appointments, verify identity, and ensure readiness for the visit. 
 Conduct pre-visit intake, including review of demographics, consent, and any required pre-screening questions. 
 Perform technology checks when appropriate (e.g., audio, video readiness) to prevent delays during the visit. 
 Set a professional, welcoming tone that builds trust and positions the patient for a positive care experience. 
 Take inbound calls to assist patients with questions about their visit, scheduling, or technical navigation. 
 
  Communication and Documentation   
 
 Maintain accurate documentation of patient outreach, intake, call routing, and handoff activities in the designated system(s).

title: AIT MGSE Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

In your capacity as MAIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

What we would love to see from you

In the role of MAIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

description:
Senior Analytics Engineer Marketing & Growth : You will own and architect the systems and definitions that determine how every euro of marketing spend is measured, audited, and optimized. Your work will directly shape how we understand acquisition performance, allocate budgets, and scale efficiently across markets. You will join a lean, 4 person team working on mission-critical initiatives in a fast-growing, design-driven environment.

At PERGOLUX, we value integrity, innovation, ambition, and unity — and we build systems with the same care and precision as our products.

  • Build and own the Single Source of Truth for Marketing and Storefront, defining CAC, Engagement, and core performance metrics with clarity, consistency, and auditability.

  • Design and build Data Health metrics that bring visibility to the quality, accuracy, freshness and completeness of our marketing and storefront data

  • Partner closely with marketing, storefront, and leadership stakeholders to drive faster, smarter decisions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Minimum 5 years experience in analytics engineering roles

Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Many teams in the region already run NetBird through our open source and self-serve products, and you'll turn that adoption into annual cloud and self-hosted enterprise contracts while opening new mid-market and enterprise accounts. title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
description:

In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions.   • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers.

title: Senior Payload Integration Engineer - UGV Platforms  (m/f/d)

As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing. 


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations.

title: Internship
description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

This is a 4-month program: 3 months in Berlin, 1 month in New York. You’ll join one of our tracks (CEO Office, Growth, Product, Ops or Talent) and own real work from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects.


Recent projects run by interns:

  • Rebuilt our talent engine and cut time-to-fill from 82 days to 34.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit.

Wil jij aan het begin van jouw loopbaan direct meewerken aan onderzoek dat bijdraagt aan de koers van Nederland? Bij Berenschot werk je in een dynamisch team van adviseurs op het gebied van water en ruimte. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen én tegelijkertijd maatschappelijke impact te maken.

description:
About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

Role Overview

We’re looking for founding members of our Emerging Enterprise Account Executive Team in EMEA — sellers who thrive in high-growth environments and can open, develop, and close complex deals in technical markets. You’ll own a list of named prospects in markets across the EMEA region, drive outbound pipeline creation, close the initial deal, and continue to nurture and grow your accounts.

This role requires ownership of the entire sales cycle as well as direct revenue responsibility for achieving and exceeding our sales goals. The role requires a deep technical understanding and curiosity to serve as a trusted advisor to prospective customers.
