title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
description:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

You’ll be the first engineer dedicated to our data platform, and you’ll design and build it largely from scratch. You’ll own the platform that collects our event data, models it, and serves it to customers with roughly 15-second freshness, including building our time-series foundations. This is a senior, hands-on role: you’ll set the architecture, write most of the code and set the bar for the data team that grows around you. You’ll work closely with our VP of Engineering, Product and our leadership team. Product decides which data products to build; you own how they’re built and what the data can support.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Designing and building real-time ingestion for three sources: events our platform already emits, new instrumentation in our product, and data our customers send us

  • Rebuilding our event streaming layer, with the authority to choose how

  • Modelling structured and time-series data in ClickHouse and Databricks so aggregations, trends and benchmarks are fast and cheap at scale (our current defaults, though you can make the case for change)

  • Designing the external data contracts and APIs customers build on, including versioning, reliability and isolation of each customer’s data

Company

Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI.

We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure.

By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure.

Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch.

Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone.

Please review our Hugging Face and GitHub repos before applying, as they’ll be part of the interview discussion.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Swedish Speaking)
description:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

 

We are looking for a Swedish Speaking New business Account Executive. You won't be pitching a CMS. title: Pentester Senior / Red Team

Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI.

Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence.

Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents.

Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse.

title: Stage Frontoffice
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Een goede eerste indruk maken én jezelf ontwikkelen in gastvrijheid en communicatie? Daar krijg je tijdens jouw meewerkstage bij de Frontoffice volop de kans voor. Je bent een van de eerste aanspreekpunten voor bezoekers en bellers en leert hoe je hen vriendelijk en professioneel helpt. Je ontvangt gasten bij de receptie, neemt de telefoon op en voert verschillende administratieve werkzaamheden uit. Zo doe je in de praktijk ervaring op met receptiewerk, telefonie, hospitality, communicatie en administratie.

Omdat we internationaal werken, krijg je ook te maken met buitenlandse bezoekers en telefoongesprekken. Je hoeft natuurlijk nog geen perfecte Engelse gesprekken te voeren. Het belangrijkste is dat je het leuk vindt om Engels in de praktijk te gebruiken en hierin steeds beter te worden. Wanneer het rustiger is bij de Frontoffice, dan ondersteun je bij Travel. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld met de administratie rondom zakelijke reizen, het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens en, waar mogelijk, het boeken van hotels en vluchten. Zo ontdek je niet alleen hoe de Frontoffice werkt, maar krijg je ook inzicht in het organiseren van zakelijke reizen.

Concreet ga je je bezighouden met:

  • Bezoekers ontvangen en leren hoe je zorgt voor een gastvrije en professionele ontvangst;

  • De telefoon aannemen en bellers doorverbinden of verder helpen;

  • Ervaring opdoen met Nederlandse én Engelse telefoongesprekken;

  • Werken met administratieve werkzaamheden en systemen;

  • Ondersteunen bij Travel, bijvoorbeeld bij het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens;

  • Waar mogelijk helpen bij het boeken van hotels en vluchten voor zakelijke reizen;

  • Steeds zelfstandiger meedraaien in de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van de Frontoffice.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Financial Experience
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Financial Experience (FinXP), the team that builds how practices and patients deal with money at Nelly.

That covers how a patient says yes to a treatment they can’t pay for upfront, and how delivered care becomes an invoice, then a payment, then cash in the practice’s account. You’ll lead a team whose work shows up directly in what practices earn and in what Nelly earns.

The problem space: Practices rarely lose revenue because care isn’t needed. They lose it at two points. Before treatment, patients delay or decline because they can’t pay upfront. After treatment, revenue leaks on its way to cash: invoices go out late or wrong, payments get chased by hand, and billing runs through manual steps. The domain Financial OS closes both gaps. We offer financing at the moment the patient decides, through installment plans and factoring, and we turn every delivered treatment into a correct invoice and cash in the practice’s account. Because we sit where treatment is planned, we know what it’s worth and whether it is converted before we take on the risk, which no bank or payment provider can do. We earn a share of the revenue we help collect, so the practice’s growth is our growth.

The domain has two teams. Financial Platform builds the infrastructure that moves money and keeps compliant records of it. Financial Experience builds everything doctors, practice staff, patients and our own teams touch, across the Doctor Portal, Patient Portal and Backoffice.

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.

title: STAGE Fullstack - Refonte d'un moteur de recherche à forte volumétrie (H/F)
description:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

Contexte
Plusieurs moteurs de recherche internes tournent sur nos catalogues, volumineux et à forte fréquence de mise à jour. L'un d'eux renvoie aujourd'hui trop de bruit et hiérarchise mal ses résultats.
 
Comment améliorer la pertinence et la lisibilité des résultats en étant aussi rapide que le demande un usage temps réel ? 

Objectifs du stage
  • Reprendre le moteur sur le fond et sur la forme : améliorer l'algorithme pour éliminer les résultats parasites, ajouter des filtres dynamiques, retravailler l'ergonomie et la hiérarchisation de l'information
  • Enrichir la saisie avec des suggestions basées sur les tendances de consult

Notre portail développeur tourne sous Backstage, et la conformité de nos composants y est aujourd'hui contrôlée par un plugin communautaire. Celui-ci est monolithique et limité à ce que Backstage connaît, c'est-à-dire les composants déclarés dans son catalogue.
Tout le reste du SI — code source hors catalogue, ressources cloud, métriques — n'est contrôlé automatiquement par personne.
 
Comment construire une solution maison capable de définir, collecter et évaluer des règles de conformité sur l'ensemble du SI ?

title: STAGE - ASSISTANT(E) VISUAL DESIGN CREATION (H/F) - NOVEMBRE 2026 (6 MOIS)
description:
LA MAISON
 
Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.
 
Pour accompagner la forte croissance de la Maison, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Assistant(e) en VISUAL DESIGN CREAT

title: Account Manager

About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

Synthesia is the #1 Enterprise AI video generation since 2016, and today we work with 90% of the Fortune 100. Our core product, Studio, lets anyone turn a script into a polished video with an AI avatar, no camera or crew required.

Now we're entering a new chapter. We're making those avatars interactive. Instead of watching a video, people can have a real conversation with one: ask it questions, practice a sales pitch, run through a training scenario, get answers back in real time.

That shift needs a story, and you own it. As Head of Product Marketing, you lead the function that decides how the whole product line is positioned, messaged, and launched. Video, interactive avatars, the API, and whatever comes next.

You'll set the platform narrative and keep it sharp as the product evolves. You'll run launches across the portfolio, own competitive strategy and buyer research, and set the messaging that sales, web, and campaigns all run on.

Why this job posting

We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent.

The best hires rarely arrive the moment a perfectly matching job posting happens to be live. So we're not waiting. You might not fit one of our current open roles, and that's fine. If you're genuinely great at what you do, we want you, and we'll find work for you!

Tell us what you're brilliant at and where you'd have the most impact, and we'll figure out the right seat together.

What it's like to work here

A few things that are true about working here:

We move fast. Really fast. Hours and days, not weeks or months.

We keep it light. Few meetings, little bureaucracy, less talking and more doing. And we default to doing it ourselves before adding dependencies, because pulling other people in slows everything down for everyone.

We hold a high bar. Average loses.

We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.

It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. title: AI Developer for Learning Products
description:
Jellyfish is a full service global digital agency, combining strategy, creative, data and media buying and planning expertise with technology under one integrated roof. With almost 2,000 Jellies across 38 offices worldwide, we are the unconventional global marketing partner of the future.

We understand both brand and activation. We ensure our clients reach, influence and connect with the right audiences and fans based on data that reveals the insights to deliver exceptional creative solutions across any platform. In short, we create and deliver culturally relevant creativity that cuts through the clutter and sets hearts (and feeds) on fire.

As part of the Brandtech Group we’re at the forefront of the deployment of GenAI tools across every aspect of what we do and in PencilPro we have the world’s No 1 generative AI platform, revolutionising the process of creative production, distribution and performance prediction.

Job Description

Reporting to the Head of People Development, you will turn our learning ideas into working products. Our Education and Experience team designs how more than 7,000 people across the Brandtech Group learn, grow and perform, and we prototype fast with AI coding tools. You'll take those prototypes and make them into reliable, secure apps that people use every day.

Our goal is to turn all of our learning into an agentic solution that meets employees where they are, so they can learn in real time, in the flow of work. You'll join a small, distributed team, work alongside a senior architect who owns our core platform, and grow your craft as our products grow.

Including conducting analysis of potential suspicious activity across a range of financial crime escalations, producing reports for both internal and external audiences, and providing support across the wider team where needed.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus was founded by Simon Porte Jacquemus in 2009 in Paris, France.
Dedicated to the memory of the designer’s late mother, the brand draws inspiration from a passion for culture. The Jacquemus ready-to-wear and accessories collections for men and women reference the French way of life and universal gestures of beauty, encompassing influences from fine art photography to decorative arts, cinema, painting, and sculpture.

Based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, Jacquemus is an independent fashion house with over 300 employees. Renowned for its fast-growing digital presence and its worldwide business spread, the brand has created innovative retail experiences around the world before opening its first permanent flagship store at 58 Avenue Montaigne in Paris in 2022. Following this milestone, international boutiques have opened in New York (SoHo), London (New Bond Street), Los Angeles (Melrose Avenue) and Dubai.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) C-UAS
description:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes- the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments- and lead the software integration of modular Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) sensors and effectors. You will deploy, harden, integrate, and operate our modular C-UAS solution.

Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement genuinely calls for it — initial standup, in-SCIF integration work, on-the-ground incident response, training, and knowledge transfer- and you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero the rest of the time. The job is being their engineer, not living at their desk.

You are a cross-functional engineering leader. You can take responsibility for the full breadth of a data and software integration platform- make it work where it has to work, analyze what's running through it, and solve problems in real time for the mission hero. About 20% of your time, you'll also help make Defense Unicorns' forward-deployed team better — pairing with junior Data Engineer FDEs on hard problems, helping them develop technical judgment, and raising the ceiling on what the team can take on.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and harden UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment — stand up UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required.

  • Own integration with existing mission systems — connect UDS Data Capability to existing infrastructure, including sensor arrays, computer-vision-enabled UAS interceptors, and a broad range of C-UAS solutions.

  • Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries — ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions.

  • Operate what you deploy — own initial day-2 operations, including capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Transition ownership to the mission hero's operations team once stable.

  • Generate accreditation artifacts — STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings to support ISSM/ISSO requirements in IL4/IL5 environments.

title: Compliance Lead - CMMC (NIST SP 800-171)

Role Description

We are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations. This person is the customer-facing lead for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 engagements and owns NIST SP 800-171 interpretation, scoping, documentation, and assessment readiness from kickoff through the C3PAO assessment and into sustainment. Compliance Lead decides what the systems must satisfy, can configure the controls personally in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 GCC High, writes the record that proves it, and verifies the result the way an assessor would.

They are the day-to-day point of contact for their assigned customers and answer CMMC questions with authority and in plain terms. This person has to be versatile enough to work in all of them.

  • Lead each engagement through the standard delivery process from intake to assessor-ready package, holding the stage gates and evidence standards.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - MED
description:
Enterprise Account Executive, TradFi & Web3 Enterprise, MED (France & Italy)

Our Account Executives help organisations adopt digital assets with confidence by connecting their business needs to Chainalysis's blockchain intelligence solutions. They build trusted customer relationships, develop new business, and grow existing accounts through a consultative sales approach.

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to cover France, Italy and Malta within our SEMEA team. Your primary focus will be two segments: traditional finance (TradFi), including retail, commercial, private and investment banks, payment and e-money institutions, and asset managers that are launching, supporting or exposed to digital asset activity; and the largest Web3 players, including major exchanges, brokers, custodians, stablecoin issuers and digital asset infrastructure providers operating at scale in France and Italy.

You will own your territory strategy, navigate complex and highly regulated sales cycles, and engage stakeholders across compliance, financial crime, risk, security, procurement, digital assets and executive leadership, from bank CCOs to the compliance and security leaders of large crypto platforms. We measure success through quota attainment, new customer acquisition, and account growth across France and Italy.

In this role, you'll

  • Exceed your sales quota by acquiring new customers and growing existing accounts across France and Italy, with a primary focus on TradFi institutions and large Web3 enterprises.

  • Develop and execute territory and strategic account plans that reflect each market's banking and digital asset landscape, regulatory environment, and buying processes.

title: Head of Financial Controller
description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

As Head of Financial Controller, you will own the full accounting function across Filigran's entities, including revenue recognition, consolidation, monthly and year-end close, and internal controls. You will act as the finance function's technical backbone building the infrastructure, controls, and processes needed to support a fast-scaling, multi-entity, international organization.

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
About Withings

Based in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Withings designs connected health devices that measure what your body is already saying: smart scales, hybrid smartwatches, blood pressure monitors, sleep analyzers, a connected stethoscope, and Withings+, the service that turns everyday data into a long-term reading of your health. Our products are sold around the world.

The brand rests on a fine balance of medical rigor, premium design and a warm tone. Our products are built to last for years, not for a single product cycle.

Your body already knows. Withings helps you hear it.

Your Role

As Senior Graphic Designer, you will be the graphic backbone of our in-house creative studio. You will create, adapt, challenge and grow the Withings brand image, from product launches to brand guidelines, and imagine the visuals that bring our products to life around the world.

The studio is responsible for the graphic quality of every brand touchpoint, including product launches, communication and promotional campaigns, and high-impact projects for our markets in Europe, the United States and beyond, always to a premium standard. You will work alongside a motion designer and 3D artist and a graphic design apprentice to bring to life our premium universe, which we are reinventing for 2027.

We are looking for a true creative at heart: an experienced designer who loves and needs to imagine, experiment and make. This senior role includes a large share of hands-on production, as you will design and execute your own work from concept to final file. You bring new ideas, defend them and carry them through to execution, and you raise the brand's visual bar without waiting to be asked.

AI is already part of how the studio creates, with tools such as Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, and its role keeps growing. You know how to use it to create more, faster, without compromising quality.

description:

Vos principales missions

  • Vous réalisez les investigations de terrain (forages, sondages, essais in situ, prélèvements et mesures) et assurez la qualité des données collectées.

title: Chef de produit digital F/H
description:
LIANAKA est une filiale du Groupe Fondasol, spécialiste de l’ingénierie conseil de la construction.

Allier le meilleur des données de sols, de l’IA et de l’analyse humaine dans une plateforme technologiquement avancée, pour permettre aux porteurs de projets de construction d’anticiper les risques et de saisir les opportunités liées à l'environnement des sites de leurs projets : tel est l’engagement de LIANAKA.

Dès la recherche foncière, notre plateforme délivre aux acteurs de la construction un accès direct à une information globale, qualifiée et synthétique des risques et opportunités du sous-sol.

Chaque phase du projet est également l’opportunité d’optimiser les hypothèses techniques et les solutions de travaux.

Les bénéfices directs pour nos clients? Une fiabilité des données du sous-sol optimisée, sur les critères eau, pollution des sols, géotechnique et géothermie. Une meilleure anticipation et maitrise de leurs projets. Des décisions prises plus rapidement. Une identification immédiate des gains financiers. Une contribution à l’empreinte environnementale des projets. Le tout dans un environnement digital convivial et agile. 

Soyez le pivot stratégique de notre transformation numérique : entre expertise technique et performance commerciale, portez le succès d'une solution SaaS qui révolutionne l'analyse des risques de la construction.

Le Projet

Dans le cadre de notre développement numérique, le Groupe FONDASOL a déployé une plateforme SaaS innovante LIANAKA dédiée à la modélisation et l’analyse des risques du sous-sol. Elle offre aux acteurs de la construction une information fiable, rapide et optimisée en amont de leurs projets.

description:

Vous assurez le staging, la configuration et les tests des infrastructures IT avant déploiement, en collaboration étroite avec les Chefs de Projets ou en totale autonomie sur les déploiements standards.

Vos missions :

Staging & configuration

  • Tests approfondis avant expédition ou dans le cadre du SAV

Déploiement & support technique

title: Ingénieur(e) Avant-Vente Infrastructures & Téléphonie IP (H/F)
description:
Informadis | Les Ulis (91) | CDI Cadre | 50–60 K€ package | Déplacements nationaux

Qui sommes-nous ?

INFORMADIS est le partenaire informatique du réseau E.Leclerc. Nous accompagnons les magasins adhérents et leurs centrales régionales (SCA) dans leurs projets IT : téléphonie IP, réseau et sécurité (firewalls, switches…), hébergement en datacenter, logiciel de comptabilité Space X, matériel informatique, impression, et services managés / helpdesk.

Nos projets vont d’un magasin à plusieurs sites en déploiement simultané. Pour soutenir cette croissance, nous renforçons notre équipe d’avant-vente.

Le poste

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Commerce, vous êtes le pont entre les commerciaux et les équipes techniques. Vous transformez le besoin d’un magasin ou d’une centrale régionale en une solution concrète, chiffrée et convaincante. Vous intervenez sur tout le périmètre infrastructure (réseau et sécurité, téléphonie IP, hébergement), du magasin unique aux réseaux multi-sites, depuis la première visite jusqu’au passage en production.

Vos missions

Recueil et analyse du besoin

  • Qualifier les opportunités avec les commerciaux : périmètre, nombre de sites, enjeux, budget

  • Auditer l’existant réseau (LAN/WAN, liens opérateurs, Wi-Fi, sécurité), téléphonie, parc et hébergement

  • Rencontrer les directeurs de magasin, les responsables informatiques et les centrales

  • Identifier les risques techniques : câblage, liens opérateurs, fin du RTC, compatibilité du matériel

Conception réseau et sécurité

  • Concevoir les architectures LAN/WAN des magasins

title: Data, Automatisation & IA – Investissement à impact
description:
L’investissement à impact est un secteur d’activité en forte croissance. INCO Ventures, acteur clé de ce domaine en France, gère et conseille six fonds d’investissement dédiés au financement des entreprises à fort impact social et/ou environnemental. Il investit principalement dans des cibles en changement d’échelle et/ou en développement (tickets d’investissement compris entre 300k€ et 2M€).

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Nous sommes une société de gestion spécialisée dans l’investissement à impact. Nous accompagnons des entreprises qui contribuent aux grandes transitions environnementales et sociales, tout en recherchant une performance financière attractive pour nos investisseurs.

Au fil des années, nous avons construit nos outils et nos processus autour d’Airtable, de différentes solutions SaaS et d’usages ponctuels de l’intelligence artificielle. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement.

Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape.

Notre ambition est de construire une véritable plateforme data et IA au service de l’ensemble de notre écosystème :

  • L’équipe de gestion

  • Les équipes middle office et conformité

  • Nos investisseurs (LPs)

  • Les entreprises de notre portefeuille

Concrètement, nous souhaitons faire évoluer notre architecture de données, automatiser davantage nos processus, déployer des usages IA à forte valeur ajoutée et créer des espaces digitaux permettant à chacun d’accéder simplemen

title: Stagiaire en Comptabilité
description:
Dans le cadre du développement de notre équipe comptable, nous recherchons un(e) Stagiaire en Comptabilité de niveau Master, en fin d’études ou en année de césure, pour accompagner l’équipe dans la gestion des opérations comptables courantes.

Ce stage constitue une véritable immersion au sein d’un service comptable et vous permettra de développer votre autonomie, votre rigueur et votre maîtrise des processus comptables.

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe comptable, vous participerez notamment aux missions suivantes :

  • Tenue et suivi du courrier du service comptable ;

  • Suivi du workflow des factures fournisseurs : contrôle du circuit de validation, suivi des factures en attente et identification des éventuels blocages ;

  • Import et intégration des écritures comptables :

factures d’achats ;

factures de ventes ;

opérations bancaires ;

  • Contrôle de la cohérence des écritures importées ;

  • Participation aux travaux de saisie, de contrôle et de révision comptable ;

  • Participation aux différents travaux comptables du quotidien et contribution à l’amélioration des processus du service.


Vous êtes actuellement en Master en Comptabilité, Finance, Gestion ou Audit, et recherchez un stage de fin d’études ou une année de césure.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne :

  • Rigoureuse et organisée ;

  • Autonome et capable de respecter les délais ;

  • À l’aise avec les chiffres et les outils informatiques ;

  • Curieuse et souhaitant approfondir ses connaissances en comptabilité ;

  • Dotée d’un bon esprit d’analyse et d’équipe ;

  • Avec une réelle envie de découvrir le fonctionnement d’un service comptable.

title: Head of Expansion South-West Europe
description:
Fastned is on a mission to accelerate the transition to electric mobility. Since 2012, we have been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations across Europe powered entirely by solar and wind energy. This role offers you the unique opportunity to be at the forefront of driving this transition across France, Italy and Spain.

The role

The role combines people leadership, strategic implementation and governance. You will strengthen local ownership while creating alignment, sharing learnings and improving execution across the South-West region.

This role is based in Paris (France) and requires regular travel within Europe.

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

You will also help ensure that clients understand the value of DNV's digital offerings, experience smooth adoption, and realize benefits quickly. Working across global teams and time zones, you will connect customer needs with product, implementation and support teams. You will establish a consistent approach to onboarding, change enablement, customer health and value measurement while allowing for differences in business-group needs and regional ways of working.  No cold calling. No chasing. No building a pipeline from scratch. When a consumer who's ready to buy gets transferred to you, you pick up, build trust fast, and get them to the finish line. If you're a closer who's been stuck doing everything except closing, this is the seat where you just do what you're best at.


 
 But let's be clear about what this role actually rewards: conversion. Not activity, not hours logged, not how many calls you can make. We're measuring one thing, how many of the good leads we give you turn into funded loans. If you close, we keep feeding you. If you don't, this isn't the fit.


 
 
 Who wins in this seat:
 

 
 
 You close what's in front of you. You've got a track record of turning leads into funded deals. You know your conversion rate, and you're proud of it. That number is what gets you this job.


 
 You build trust fast. These are purchase leads comparing multiple offers. The LO who wins isn't the one who talks fastest or pushes hardest. It's the one the borrower trusts in the first two minutes. Warmth and competence close more live transfers than pressure ever will.


 
 You own the process. From the first call to structuring the file to delivering confidence to a nervous buyer, you know mortgages well enough to handle a live consumer in real time without fumbling.


 
 You move fast and stay sharp. Live transfers reward people who are responsive, organized, and ready. Leads are an opportunity, not a guarantee. You treat every one like it matters. 
 
 
 About the leads:  Live transfers are the headline, but they’re not the only fuel. You’ll also work our online leads and AI-matched leads, which reward a different muscle: fast first contact and disciplined follow-up until the borrower picks up. Killers do both. They close what’s handed to them live, and they don’t let an online lead go cold because it didn’t answer the first time.


 
 
 What we provide:
 

 
 Live, pre-screened purchase leads from consumers ready to compare offers. You're their closer. Real support to help you convert, including a national team of about 50 producing LOs and a Slack where questions get answered in about five minutes, even nights and weekends. Every purchase deal is also a chance to build a relationship with the agent on the transaction, turning one closed loan into an ongoing referral source. 50+ lenders, a full broker product shelf, and no income caps. If you can close, we can keep you fed.


 
 We've been doing this 20+ years (NMLS 4190). Our CEO and President still fund loans every day

title: Tester
description:
About pkconsult

We design and build business-critical information systems that help our clients to improve their business intelligence. Operating as a tight-knit team in Berlin, we focus on delivering reliable software that powers core operations for our partners.

What you will do

  • Evaluate business-critical information systems to verify functionality and performance against client requirements.

  • Identify defects and edge cases through systematic testing before features reach production.

  • Collaborate directly with developers to isolate issues and trace root causes in complex software environments.

  • Maintain test documentation and report findings clearly to keep engineering cycles on track.

What you bring

  • Demonstrated experience in software quality assurance and systematic testing methodologies.

  • Familiarity with inspecting business-critical systems and identifying functional discrepancies.

  • Strong analytical approach to troubleshooting and documenting technical issues.

  • Clear communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Your first months at pkconsult

You will take ownership of testing our current release cycle, running systematic checks on active client projects, and setting up structured test cases alongside the development team. If you match most of these requirements and are ready to dig into complex software systems, we encourage you to apply.

Compensation and benefits

EUR 42,000–58,000 per year

  • 24 vacation days per year

Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens im Münchner Osten suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „Bankkaufmann Kreditsanalyse (m/w/d)“.

Aufgaben

  • Als Kreditanalyst (m/w/d) prüfen und bearbeiten Sie Kreditanträge im privaten und gewerblichen Kreditgeschäft und erstellen Entscheidungsvorlagen
  • Zudem analysieren Sie wirtschaftliche Unterlagen, bewerten die Bonität und Kapitaldienstfähigkeit und unterstützen bei der Ratingermittlung
  • Darüber hinaus bearbeiten und verwalten Sie Kreditsicherheiten, Sicherungsverträge und Beleihungsunterlagen
  • Zusätzlich erstellen Sie Beschlussvorlagen, bearbeiten Überziehungsanträge und bereiten den Schriftverkehr mit Notaren vor
  • Dabei überwachen Sie laufende Kreditengagements, führen erforderliche Kontrollen durch und begleiten die internen Genehmigungsprozesse

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Bankkaufmann (m/w/d)
  • Besonders passend ist einschlägige Berufserfahrung als Kreditsachbearbeiter (m/w/d), Sachbearbeiter Kreditgeschäft (m/w/d) oder Kreditspezialist (m/w/d)
  • Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse in der Kreditantragsbearbeitung im privaten und gewerblichen Kreditgeschäft mit
  • Zusätzlich verfügen Sie über Erfahrung in der Bonitätsprüfung, Sicherheitenbearbeitung und Bewertung wirtschaftlicher Unterlagen
  • Wichtig sind eine sorgfältige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise, Belastbarkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten, 32 Tage Urlaub sowie anteilige Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
  • Sicherheit: Unbefristete Festanstellung im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

title: Agent Security Engineer
description:
Belmont Lavan is hiring an Agent Security Engineer to secure autonomous AI agents before and after they reach production. Agents now call tools, hold credentials and act on live systems, so they need the controls we already expect for people and services: identity, least-privilege access, monitoring and testing.

You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning
  • Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management
  • Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust
  • Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar)
  • Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives

title: Designer (Freelance, m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with offices in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K/3D/360° streaming technology and innovative live formats, we are changing the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

Your Role

As Designer, you shape how L1VE looks and how people experience it, from the first ad to the ticket purchase on our website. Our website is at the heart of the role: you design user journeys and pages that convert. You also create our event banners, flyers, ads and social assets. You take full ownership of design, build it up from the start and keep it lean, flexible and fast.
You work closely with our Social Media Manager, our Content & Experience team and Product & Tech, and report to the Head of Marketing & Sales.

  • Full-time (5 days/week), project-based, 12 months
  • Work remotely within Europe or Asia, or on-site in Berlin

What You'll Do

  • Design and continuously improve our website, from first visit to ticket purchase, and make it instantly clear what L1VE is: a real live broadcast you experience with a VR headset
  • Map and optimize user journeys; create wireframes, prototypes and final designs in Figma
  • Design for conversion: identify drop-offs, develop hypotheses and test page and flow variants based on analytics data
  • Hand over developer-ready, responsive designs and build a clear design system with reusable components
  • Design landing pages, key visuals and asset packages for our live events (banners, flyers, posters, on-site materials) and for email campaigns
  • Create paid ads for social and display (static and simple motion) in all required formats, with variations for A/B testing
  • Follow the design guidelines of our license partners precisely, keep our brand consistent, and brief external freelancers or agencies when more capacity is needed

description:
Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin.

Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch.

Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden.

Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung: Vollzeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marketingstrategie & Umsetzung: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Gründer:in und dem restlichen Kreativteam die Markenstrategie von Cell Labs weiter und gestaltest u. a. den bevorstehenden Produktlaunch aktiv mit, von Messaging über Kampagnen bis zu Events.

  • Content & Kommunikation: Du übersetzt komplexe Robotik-Technologien in verständliche und überzeugende Inhalte für unsere Website, Social Media, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle. Dafür arbeitest du eng mit unseren Gründern, dem Brand- und Designteam sowie den Engineers zusammen.

  • Go-to-Market: Du planst und steuerst Marketingkampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels, entwickelst Maßnahmen zur B2B-Leadgenerierung und machst Cell Labs bei relevanten Industrieunternehmen und Partnern sichtbar.

  • Events & Kooperationen: Du planst und begleitest relevante Messen, Konferenzen und Partneraktivitäten

title: AI Security Researcher
description:
About the Role



As an AI Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in AI/ML security, software development in Python, backed by a minimum MSc in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with AI workloads, large language models, training frameworks, advanced optimization algorithms, GPU clusters, and ideally SLURM in HPC environments. You excel at modeling AI threats—model/data poisoning, permission escalation, backdoors, data drift attacks, prompt injection—and translating them into practical security defenses.

You will be one of Haste's first AI security researchers pioneering defenses for trillion-parameter AI training environments alongside HPC and quantum workloads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Adversarial Threat Research: Investigating emerging attack vectors and developing techniques to uncover vulnerabilities in AI models, data pipelines, and infrastructure.
  • Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis: Mapping and characterizing potential threats across the AI lifecycle—from data ingestion to deployment—to prioritize security investments.
  • Developing Defenses & Guardrails: Designing and implementing detection logic and researching mitigation methods to AI threats.
  • Collaborating with Engineering Teams: Translating research findings into actionable, production-grade security requirements for product teams, ensuring threat detection makes sense.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization or to the public.
  • Monitoring AI Ecosystem Trends: Staying updated on the latest AI security standards, frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS), and academic research.

Requirements

  • University degree

title: Product Engineering Lead
description:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.

I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.

Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.

That means a top-notch engineer who leads from the codebase. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You'll ship every week and lead the team's biggest technical work — and as the team grows, you'll grow into managing it.

You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.

— Grigory

title: Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d) Digital Health
description:
Wir helfen Menschen mit Nahrungsmittelunverträglichkeiten schnell und unkompliziert zu weniger Beschwerden. Das machen wir mit unserer App viatolea: Auf der Basis eines Ernährungs- und Symptomtagebuchs können wir mithilfe der Kombination aus moderner Technologie und Expertenwissen individuelle Unverträglichkeiten erkennen. Danach startet die personalisierte Ernährungsumstellung in der App – als zertifiziertes Medizinprodukt.

Metropolregion Nürnberg – Vollzeit ab sofort

Aufgaben

Als unsere erste Marketingkraft baust du das Growth Marketing von Grund auf mit auf und hast vom ersten Tag an echten Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Marketingstrategie für die B2C-Vermarktung der App weiter und setzt sie um.

  • Du legst KPIs wie CAC und ROAS fest, erweiterst unser Setup für Tracking und Reporting und leitest aus den Zahlen Budget- und Kanalentscheidungen ab.

  • Du baust unsere Performance-Kanäle aus, vor allem Paid Social (Meta) und Google Ads, und skalierst die Kanäle, die sich an diesen Kennzahlen bewähren.

  • Du analysierst den Funnel von der ersten Anzeige bis zur aktiven App-Nutzung, findest die größten Abbrüche und optimierst Website und Landingpages mit hypothesenbasierten A/B-Tests.

  • Du konzipierst Inhalte für Online- und Offline-Kanäle (SEO, Social Media, Content Marketing, Events, Print) und setzt sie (ggf. unter Einbeziehung externer Dienstleister) um.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Growth oder Performance Marketing, idealerweise für eine B2C-App oder ein anderes digitales Produkt.

  • Du denkst in Funnels und Unit Economics und triffst Entscheidungen anhand von Kennzahlen wie CAC und ROAS.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Conversion-Optimierung und A/B-Tests für Websites und Landingpages und bist sicher im Umgang mit Tracking- und Analyse-Tools.

  • Du berätst interne Fachbereiche bei steuerlichen Fragestellungen und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Steuerexperten.
  • Du baust eine zentrale Dokumentationsbibliothek für steuerrelevante Unterlagen auf und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Fiskalvertretern im In- und Ausland.
  • Du begleitest steuerliche Betriebsprüfungen sowie interne und externe Audits.

Du hast dein Studium im Bereich Technik oder Ingenieurswesen abgeschlossen oder hast eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit (elektro-) technischem Background und suchst nach einer spannenden Herausforderung? Du möchtest mit State-of-the-Art-Technologien arbeiten und an Projekten mitwirken, die die Zukunft gestalten? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Spectrum ist ein zukunftsorientiertes, mittelständisches Unternehmen nahe Hamburg, das sich auf die Entwicklung und Produktion hochmoderner, ultraschneller, elektronischer Systeme spezialisiert hat. Unsere Produkte werden für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen in Forschung und Industrie eingesetzt, wie z.B. Akustik, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Astronomie, Kommunikationstechnologie, Fiber Optik, Hochspannungstests, Laser, Lidar, Medizintechnik, Nanotechnologie, Radar, Spektroskopie oder Ultraschall. Zu unseren Kunden gehören namhafte Industrieunternehmen wie Bosch, NXP, EADS, Philips, Rohde & Schwarz, Siemens, Thales sowie führende Forschungsinstitute auf der ganzen Welt wie CERN, PSI, PTB, DESY, DLR. Wir sind Teil des „Rymax One“-Konsortiums (BMBF-gefördertes Quantencomputer-Projekt) und unterstützen die Quantenforschung mit hochmodernen Produkten.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Du bist eng mit unseren Vertriebspartnern und Kunden verbunden, hauptsächlich in Nordamerika sowie in Deutschland, Europa und Asien, und kümmerst dich um neue und laufende Projekte. Du bist verantwortlich für die technische Beratung von Anwendern, Projekt- und Vertriebspartnern, für das Nachverfolgen von Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, das Entwickeln von Konzepten zur Umsetzung der Anwendungen sowie das Schulen der Vertriebspartner. Zudem fungierst du als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden und unserer Entwicklungsabteilung. Deine Arbeit basiert vor allem auf digitalen Kommunikationsmitteln und Reisen sind nur nach vorheriger Absprache in besonderen Fällen erforderlich.

title: Chief of Staff - Operations
description:
Über Ralph

Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Warum das wichtig ist

Die Verwaltung rund ums Zuhause ist oft frustrierend. Ralph macht Wohnen einfacher, effizienter und wirklich digital – ein echtes „Home in your Pocket“.

Aufgaben

  • Integration & Transformation: Du arbeitest eng mit dem VP Operations daran, neu erworbene Unternehmen sauber zu integrieren und operativ auf Ralph-Standard zu bringen.

  • Process Design: Du entwickelst Playbooks, Standards, Eskalationslogiken und Entscheidungsroutinen für wiederkehrende operative Situationen.

  • Automation: Du identifizierst manuelle, fehleranfällige Abläufe und arbeitest mit Product, Tech und Operations an besseren, automatisierten Lösungen.

  • People & Change: Du begleitest neue Arbeitsweisen, schärfst Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Veränderungen im Team wirklich ankommen.

  • Execution: Du übernimmst wichtige Transformationsprojekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Effizienz, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit.

title: Praktikum / Abschlussarbeit (m/w/d) – Software Testing Medizinprodukte
description:
Preventicus: Das sind wir

Gesundheitslösungen von morgen machen wir schon heute. Wir schaffen Mobile und Wearable Produkte für den Gesundheitssektor.

Deine Mission:

Im Rahmen eines Praktikums bei der Preventicus GmbH erhältst Du einen umfassenden Einblick in das Thema Software Testing in den Bereichen Web, Mobile und Wearables (Smartwatches). Du erlernst das Testen von Software basierend auf Spezifikationen. Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums gibt es die Möglichkeit ein Thema für eine Abschlussarbeit (Bachelor / Master) zu erstellen oder auch längerfristig als Werkstudent/in an Bord zu bleiben.

Pflichtpraktikum | 2-6 Monate | ab Februar 2027

Aufgabenschwerpunkte

  • Unterstützung des QA-Teams bei der Qualitätssicherung von Web- und Mobile Anwendungen

  • Erstellung, Pflege und Ausführung von Testfällen im Rahmen von funktionalen, System- und Regressionstests

  • Entwicklungsbegleitendes Testen von B2C- und B2B-Produkten im Bereich von mobilen und webbasierten Anwendungen

  • Selbstständige Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Pflege von Tickets in Jira

  • Erstellung von Anforderungs- und Testfallreviews sowie Testberichten

  • Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von automatisierten Funktionstests

  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Entwicklungsteam zur Ermittlung von Fehlerwirkungen und Unterstützung bei Grundursachenanalysen

Anforderungen

  • Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und möchtest dein Pflichtpraktikum in einem innovativen und technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld absolvieren

  • Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an testgetriebener Softwareentwicklung und modernen Softwaretestmethoden mit

  • Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Funktionsweise und Abläufe automat

title: Working Student Platform Engineering & DevOps (m/w/d)
description:
Über KnowWay

Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.

Die Rolle

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Platform Engineering, Systemadministration und DevOps verantwortest Du einen großen Teil unserer internen IT: Du betreibst den Technologie-Stack eines wachsenden KI-Startups und machst ihn robust und sicher.

Dabei arbeitest Du mit hoher Eigenständigkeit. Du bringst eigene Vorschläge für Architektur und Toolauswahl ein, triffst Entscheidungen mit uns gemeinsam und setzt sie selbst um.

Zusätzlich gestaltest Du die Infrastruktur unserer Produkte mit – von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Engineers.

Der Umfang liegt bei 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel planbar neben Deinem Studium.

Aufgaben

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen IT-Landschaft – von Identitäten und Geräten bis zu Servern und Entwicklerwerkzeugen

  • Architektur- und Toolentscheidungen vorbereiten, bewerten und eigenverantwortlich umsetzen

  • Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben und Infrastructure as Code

  • Betrieb und Ausbau von Container-Plattformen sowie CI/CD-Pipelines

  • Absicherung des Stacks: Zugriffskonzepte, Härtung, Patch-Management und Monitoring

title: Customer Care Specialist (m/w/d)
description:

Unser Team aus rund 40 Mitarbeitern in den Bereichen Product Management, Tech und Marketing arbeitet jeden Tag gerne und voller Leidenschaft daran, für unsere Kunden zukunftsfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln, die einen echten Mehrwert bieten.

Du hast Spaß daran, Kunden weiterzuhelfen, findest für jedes Problem eine Lösung und interessierst dich für digitale Technologien? Dann bist du bei uns richtig!

Als Specialist im Customer Care (m/w/d) bist du eine wichtige Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden. Du unterstützt sie bei Fragen rund um unsere MarTech-Lösungen, sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe und stellst sicher, dass sie das Beste aus unseren Produkten herausholen.

Aufgaben

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und kümmerst dich um ihre Anliegen – kompetent, freundlich und lösungsorientiert.

  • Du unterstützt bei Fragen zur Nutzung unserer Produkte und Services und hilfst dabei, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen.

  • Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, denkst mit und findest passende Lösungen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams zusammen, um Kundenanliegen effizient zu bearbeiten.

  • Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, unsere Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

description:
Localisation : Paris
Type de contrat : CDI

L’entreprise

Pysae édite la solution de gestion d'exploitation des réseaux de transport public : géolocalisation temps réel des véhicules, information voyageurs, pilotage des opérations. Nos clients sont les grands opérateurs du secteur — Transdev, Keolis, RATP — ainsi que des autorités organisatrices et des exploitants indépendants.

Nous connaissons une forte croissance, portée par un marché en pleine transformation numérique.

L’entreprise se développe en France, en Italie et à l’international.

Nous sommes quarante personnes basées à Rennes, Paris et Milan.

Vos missions principales

Nous recherchons un account manager pour notre équipe française, en charge de notre base de clients existants.

  • Piloter un portefeuille de clients actifs en France représentant 1 à 2 M€ d’ARR (opérateurs, autorités organisatrices, exploitants indépendants) : être leur interlocuteur commercial privilégié et garantir leur satisfaction dans la durée.

About Pysae

Pysae is a French SaaS company building real-time fleet supervision (AVM / SAEIV) and workforce management software for public transport operators. Bus networks, coach operators and transport authorities in France and across Europe rely on our platform every day to run their services, inform passengers and manage their drivers. We are a team of around 40 people based in Rennes, Paris and Italy, and we are expanding fast internationally.

Pysae has grown from a set of products into a full platform. We now need someone to tell that story, put it in front of the right people, and turn it into growth.

The role

Reporting to our Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will own product marketing and growth: generating demand through the product itself and by showcasing the value of the Pysae platform.

This is an international role. You will work on France, Italy and our new markets across Europe and beyond, with sales teams and customers in several countries and languages.

This is not a classic marketing job. Our market (public transport operators and authorities) has long been sold to in the same way: tenders, trade shows and long sales cycles. We want to break that pattern. Your mission is to invent, test and deploy new ways of selling and growing, using the product, content, data and AI as levers. It is a very exciting position, and a demanding one: you will need to come up with ideas, prove quickly whether they work, drop what doesn't and scale what does.

title: People — Employment and Labor Law  (France)
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The Employment & Labour Law role 🇫🇷

Alan is growing fast: new health services, new entities, new countries, and a 2027 People agenda with social elections and many individual situations.

Each of these brings legal obligations, and today we rely mostly on external counsel. In Alan's terms, "compliance" means everything we do to follow a mandatory rule that would become a risk if we got it wrong.

title: Quantum Dot Process & Characterisation Engineer- Post-Growth Processing (Master)
description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role overview

We are looking for a Process & Characterisation Engineer to prepare and validate GaAs/AlGaAs samples containing InAs quantum dots (QDs) through the first steps of our single-photon source fabrication flow.

The role combines hands-on cleanroom processing – chemical treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing – with optical characterisation of the QDs before and after each step. The data you produce decides whether a sample is ready to move forward, and how the process recipes should be adjusted.

You will start by running an established, well-documented procedure with rigour and consistency. As you build expertise, the role is designed to grow: within your first year, you will contribute to optimising the process, automating the measurement setups and taking ownership of sample validation for these steps, working closely with both the Production and R&D teams.

Sample preparation & processing (from day one)

  • Run the established step-by-step procedure for preparing GaAs/AlGaAs samples with InAs quantum dots.
  • Carry out the cleanroom fabrication steps: chemical surface treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing.
  • Follow recipes and operating procedures precisely, and flag any deviation, drift or anomaly as soon as it appears.
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment.

Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

We are looking for a Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration Engineer to contribute to the development and industrialization of our photonic quantum systems.

You will work on the integration of single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical/electromechanical assemblies, with a strong focus on miniaturization, automation and operation under cryogenic conditions.

This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of photonics, electronics, mechanics, automation and experimental physics.

You will contribute across the full development cycle: design, prototyping, assembly, testing, optimization and transfer toward industrial-scale production.

Your Key Responsibilities: 

    • Design and develop packaging and integration solutions for photonic and quantum devices.

eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run.

  • Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging

Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Team

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm.

Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products.

Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Guardian team in London. You will design and build production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

title: Founders Associate Intern
description:
Join Ark at an exciting stage and learn first-hand how a startup is built.

Ark builds platforms for public administrations. We entered the market about a year ago with our best-known tool, a platform for local climate action, and now work with more than 60 cities, counties and states, from Schleswig-Holstein, Munich and Berlin to small rural municipalities. We have won the German Startup Award 2026, raised €2.4 million in pre-seed and grant funding and are approaching €1 million in annual revenue.

As our Founders Associate Intern (all genders), you work side by side with our Chief of Staff Lennart, who is your day-to-day lead, and team up with our founder & CEO Ruth on selected projects. Your week has two halves. In the mornings you are part of our growth team and help win new public administrations as customers. This is the core of the role. In the afternoons you work with Lennart on whatever matters most for the company at that moment, from strategy and finance to HR and company initiatives.

You will see from the inside how a fast-growing GovTech startup wins customers, makes decisions and builds its team. If you are thinking about founding your own company one day, there are few better places to learn.

Tasks

Joining Ark as a Founders Associate Intern means a new mix of topics every week. Here is a range of potential challenges:

  • Growth: Spend your mornings with our sales team. Research and reach out to municipalities, qualify leads, book meetings and prepare customer conversations. You learn how public sector sales work and see your impact in our pipeline every week. You'll receive a bonus for each qualified demo booked.

Onwards Together!
