title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

THE ROLE 

At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

title: Broker Development Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation)
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation)

The Role

You’ll own the quality of the Lyrebird platform, from the first commit to the release gate. This is a hands-on, code-first engineering role, not manual test scripting. You’ll make our Playwright end-to-end and integration suites faster and more reliable, build contract tests that stop backend changes from silently breaking the web app, and design ways to evaluate clinical model output where exact-match assertions don’t work. You’ll also be the quality partner to our SRE function, giving them the health checks, synthetic monitors, load test results and post-deployment signals they need. When a release is ready to go, you’ll give a clear yes or no, backed by evidence.

This role suits an engineer who sees testing as a craft and treats a test suite as production code. You’re comfortable moving between TypeScript and Python in the same day, you get real satisfaction from deleting a flaky test and cutting minutes off a pipeline, and you’d rather help other engineers write better tests than be the only person who writes them. You’ll enjoy the hard problem at the centre of this role: how to prove that non-deterministic AI output is safe and accurate enough for clinicians to rely on.

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

title: Mobile Application Engineer
description:
Mobile Application Engineer

The Role

Lyrebird’s product lives or dies in a single moment: a clinician starting a consultation and trusting that every word is being captured. Today, that moment happens in the browser. As our first Mobile Application Engineer, you’ll take ownership of bringing Lyrebird to iOS and Android, starting with the capability that matters most: reliable audio capture on a phone. You’ll own the mobile application end to end, from the build pipeline and store releases to bringing our core web features into a native experience that works in the real conditions clinicians face every day.

This role suits someone who enjoys being the person who owns the whole thing. You’re comfortable moving between native platform APIs and a TypeScript codebase, you care about the unglamorous details (permissions, interruptions, flaky networks), and you get satisfaction from shipping something that simply works when it matters. You’ll enjoy the autonomy of shaping a platform from its early days, and the responsibility of building for people who can’t afford for their tools to fail mid-consultation.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role driving the success of Watershed’s customer base.

title: Regional Sales Director, Strategic Enterprise - UK
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We've scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we're now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale. 

This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You'll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK's largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services.&

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Are you a high-achieving sales professional ready to digitally transform the physical operations that power our planet? Samsara is seeking a driven Enterprise (Core) Account Executive to introduce our cutting-edge Connected Operations® Platform to Enterprise-sized customers across the UK. This is a unique opportunity to sell a much-needed product into a historically underserved market, working directly with leaders to drive real-world impact and unlock significant career progression. title: Founding Engineer - Ambient Care Startup
description:
Stage: Pre-seed. Location: Cambridge/London, UK. Comp: Competitive + Equity

About Subtle

Most families find out something's wrong too late: a fall, a missed check-in, a change no one noticed until it became a crisis. We're building ambient sensing for the elderly and vulnerable at home, technology that quietly looks out for the people we love without asking them to wear anything or change how they live. We're early. We're validating with real customers, building the first hardware, and looking for the person who'll help turn this from an idea into a product families can trust with something this personal.

We are building this from scratch inside Founders Factory's studio, with a dedicated pre-seed investment, hands-on studio support across product, design, talent and growth, and a six-month build programme to get from concept to a fundable, in-market product. This venture has secured a major European technology partner. The founding CEO is already in place. We are now looking for the technical other half of the founding team.


The role

You'll be our first engineering hire, working directly with the founder(s) and carrying real authority over what we build and how. It's a hands-on role that spans hardware and software, and a leadership one too, since you'll grow the team that follows you.

Responsibilities

  • Own hardware validation and bench testing end to end, and lead our manufacturing path. Whether that ends up being an outsourced partner or in-house, you're the one validating the sensor platform yourself and making sure whatever we ship has been properly tested before it reaches someone's home. title: Country Lead - France
description:
Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast.


Back in 2009, our Chairman Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans.


Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. We’re looking for a French Markets Guru to own and scale AnyVan’s marketing and growth in one of our most important expansion markets. Reporting to the CMO, you’ll define and execute the French go‑to‑market strategy, working closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Pricing and Operations.

This is a high‑impact, high‑ownership role: you’ll combine sharp strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, bringing deep local market insight and broad channel expertise to acquire customers, improve conversion and accelerate revenue growth. It’s fast‑paced, opportunity‑rich, and ideal for someone who loves building from the ground up.

title: Risk & Control Manager
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Risk Manager to join our Risk & Control team, part of Pleo's Second Line of Defence. You'll report to our Head of Risk and Control, helping build and run our enterprise risk management framework, from risk appetite linkage through to the risk reporting our senior leaders and committees rely on. Alongside that full ERM remit, you'll own second line oversight of security, technology and operational resilience risk, giving our technology and security teams informed, credible challenge. It's a rare mix: a broad enterprise risk role with a technology risk specialism, in a FinTech that's still shaping how it manages risk as it s

title: Senior Data Product Partner - (Spend & Control)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Central Relationship Manager
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

title: 솔루션 세일즈 매니저 (Solution Account Manager)
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     Solution Account Manager는 Enterprise Sales Team 내 솔루션영업 파트에 속해 있어요.   Enterprise Sales Team은 결제 솔루션과 단말기, 매장 운영 소프트웨어 등 토스플레이스 제품과 서비스를 기업 고객에게 세일즈하는 역할을 맡고 있어요.   단순히 제품을 판매하는 것이 아니라, 고객사의 기존 시스템과 구조에 대한 이해와 진단을 바탕으로 토스플레이스 솔루션을 제안하고, 페이스페이·토스포스 등 혁신적인 결제 경험을 대형 브랜드에 확산하는 것을 목표로 해요.   특히, 솔루션영업 파트는 매장 운영 솔루션 토스포스를 기반으로 고객사 확대와 페이스페이 영역 확대·락인을 주도하고 있어요.   고객사의 기존 솔루션 구조를 분석해 토스포스가 진입 가능한 지점을 파악하고 컨설팅부터 솔루션 고도화까지 전 과정을 담당해요. 중장기적으로는 SaaS 서비스 업종으로의 확대와 구축형 모델 사업개발을 통해 토스플레이스의 기술적 경쟁력을 고객에게 전달하려 해요.      합류하면 함께할 업무예요     중대형 브랜드 고객사가 운영하고 있는 자체 POS, ERP, 주문 시스템 등 복잡한 IT 인프라를 이해하고, 토스포스가 어디에 어떻게 연결될 수 있는지 진입 지점을 발굴해요.   다양한 업종의 신규 고객사를 발굴하고 세일즈 전략 수립 및 실행을 전담해요.   고객사와 대화하고, 내부 제품팀, 개발팀과 고객사의 요구사항을 조율하며, 맞춤형 솔루션을 함께 설계하기도 해요.      이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     중대형 브랜드 고객을 대상으로 B2B 포스 솔루션 세일즈 경험이 있는 분을 찾고 있어요. 특히 대형 고객사를 대상으로 복잡한 의사결정 구조를 파악하고 딜을 클로징해 본 경험이 있으면 좋아요.   고객사의 운영 구조를 파악해 컨설팅이 가능한 수준의 이해도를 갖추고 있으며, 고객의 요구사항을 내부 제품팀·개발팀과 논리적으로 조율하고 합의를 이끌어낼 수 있는 분이 필요해요.   특히 F&B 매장 환경이나 패션, 마트, 편의점 등 유통·리테일 포스 시스템에 대한 이해를 갖추고 계신 분이면 좋겠어요.   신규 고객 발굴부터 계약 체결, 온보딩, 안정화까지 세일즈 사이클 전체를 주도적으로 이끌어본 분을 찾고 있어요.   프로젝트 구축 및 운영 담당으로서 고객사와 밀접하게 일하며, 고객사의 요구사항에 대응하고 커뮤니케이션 창구 역할을 수행해 주셔야 해요.      이런 니즈가 있다면 잘 맞을 거에요     단순히 제품을 파는 것이 아니라, 고객의 문제를 해결하는 솔루션을 제안하고 싶어요.   기술과 비즈니스를 연결하는 것에 흥미를 느끼는 편이에요.   복잡한 포스 솔루션을 고객 언어로 쉽게 설명할 수 있고, 직접 고객사와 소통하고 컨설팅하면서 현장의 문제와 요구사항을 생생하게 느끼고 싶어요.   신규 시장을 개척하고 성과를 만들어 나가는 데 도전 의식이 있어요.   빠르게 변화하는 오프라인 환경에서 직접 딜을 만들고 성장하고 싶어요.      이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     어떤 업종의 고객사와 어떤 시스템(POS, ERP, 주문, 결제 연동, 앱 등)을 구축하거나 운영했는지 알려주세요. 무슨 직군과 주로 소통하며 문제를 해결하셨는지도 궁금해요.   개발, 기획, PM, 운영, 영업, 고객 대응 등 프로젝트를 진행하며 맡았던 역할과 기여도를 기재해 주세요.   고객사와 직접 소통하며 어려운 요구사항을 조율하여 문제를 해결한 경험이 있으시다면 구체적인 배경과 액션, 결과를 알려주세요.   매장 수, 거래액, 도입기간 단축, 시스템 안정화 등 수행하신 업무의 결과를 숫자로 표현해 주시면 좋아요.      토스플레이스로의 합류 여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격 및 입사

title: Takuutiimin ryhmäpäällikkö/ Takuutiimin esihenkilö
description: Etsimme asiakkaallemme Broman Logistics Oy:lle kokenutta esihenkilöä johtamaan takuu- ja reklamaatiokäsittelijöiden tiimiä. Tehtävässä vastaat tiimin päivittäisen työn sujuvuudesta sekä siitä, että takuu- ja reklamaatioasiat käsitellään laadukkaasti ja tehokkaasti.     Roolissa toimit tiimisi lähiesihenkilönä, tuet työntekijöitä arjen tilanteissa ja osallistut aktiivisesti toiminnan sekä toimintatapojen kehittämiseen. Raportoit konsernin takuupäällikölle ja teet yhteistyötä eri sidosryhmien, kuten keskitetyn asiakaspalvelun kanssa. Asiakaspalvelu vastaa varsinaisesta asiakasyhteydenpidosta, joten tehtävän painopiste on ennen kaikkea tiimin johtamisessa, päätöksenteossa, ongelmatilanteiden ratkaisemisessa ja takuuprosessin toimivuuden varmistamisessa.     Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis takuuasioiden asiantuntija, sillä tehtävään ja prosesseihin perehdytetään. Sen sijaan onnistumisen kannalta pidämme erityisen tärkeänä kolmea asiaa:       Ajoneuvoalan perustuntemusta.  Sinulla voi olla esimerkiksi alan koulutusta, aikaisempaa työkokemusta tai harrastuneisuuden kautta kertynyttä ymmärrystä autoista, ajoneuvotekniikasta tai varaosista. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää kaikkea valmiiksi, mutta tekninen perusymmärrys on tehtävässä tärkeä.        Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä.  Olet voinut toimia esimerkiksi tiiminvetäjänä, vuorovastaavana tai lähiesihenkilönä. Tärkeintä on, että sinulla on kokemusta ihmisten johtamisesta ja päivittäisen työn ohjaamisesta.        Asiakaspalveluosaamista.  Ymmärrät, mitä hyvä asiakaspalvelu käytännössä tarkoittaa ja osaat tarkastella tilanteita myös asiakkaan näkökulmasta. Kokemuksesi voi olla esimerkiksi myymälästä, myynnistä tai muusta asiakasrajapinnassa tehdystä työstä.      Lisäksi arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja, päätöksentekokykyä sekä halua kehittää toimintaa yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Tehtävässä tarvitset sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Ruotsin kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.     Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen (37,5 h/vko). Barona vastaa rekrytointiprosessista, ja työsopimus solmitaan suoraan Broman Logisticsin kanssa. Palkkaus määräytyy kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja sijoittuu 3 500–3 800 €/kk välille kokemuksesta ja koulutuksesta riippuen.     Tässä tehtävässä kaikkea ei tarvitse osata ensimmäisestä päivästä lähtien .  Tärkeintä on yhdistelmä ajoneuvoalan perustuntemusta, kokemusta ihmisten johtamisesta sekä ymmärrystä hyvästä asiakaspalvelusta. Loput tehtävän yksityiskohdat ja takuuprosessit voidaan opettaa.     Haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian!      Huomioithan, että hakemus tulee jättää hakulomakkeen kautta. Tietoturvasyistä emme voi käsitellä sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

title: Key Account Manager
location: Viborg Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
description: Til netIPs salgsteam i Viborg, søger vi en Key Account Manager. En erfaren relationsskaber, der kan drive og udvikle samarbejdet med kunderne.      Hos netIP arbejder man med kunderne i mange år. Og som kundens faste kontaktperson skal du kende både de løsninger, de har i dag, og de planer, der kan ændre deres behov i morgen. Du er garant for, at de som kunder i netIP oplever service, nærvær og proaktivitet.     netIP hjælper virksomheder med IT-infrastruktur og managed services, så de får en mere stabil og fremtidssikret IT-platform. Din opgave er at forstå kundens forretning og behov og bringe de rette specialister ind i samtalen, så kunden kan træffe de rigtige beslutninger på det rigtige tidspunkt.      Du holder sammen på samarbejdet   Du bliver en central del af en række kundeteams, hvor salg, teknik og rådgivning arbejder sammen om kunden. Du samler trådene: Hvad skal løses? Hvem skal involveres? Og hvad er næste skridt?     Sammen med kollegerne sikrer du således at kundens løsninger er opdaterede og relevante. Du arbejder proaktivt og er med til at identificere muligheder og behov, før kunden selv bliver opmærksom på dem.     Du behøver ikke selv have svaret på alle tekniske spørgsmål. Men du ved, hvor du får dem afklaret, og sørger for, at opgaverne kommer videre. Fra den første behovsafklaring til en ny løsning bliver sat i drift.     Du koordinerer med kollegerne og følger op, så både kunden og teamet ved, hvad der er aftalt, og hvem der har bolden.      Om dig   Du har erfaring med kundeansvar og ved, hvad det kræver at opbygge langsigtede samarbejder. Du er nysgerrig på kundernes forretning og anbefaler ændringer, når du ser noget, der kan fungere bedre.     Din erfaring kan mærkes. Du bevarer overblikket og tager ejerskab, også når tingene bliver komplekse.     Vi forestiller os, at du kommer fra IT-branchen eller et beslægtet område. Du interesserer dig for teknologi og kan se sammenhængen mellem en IT-løsning og den hverdag, den skal fungere i. Erfaring med IT-infrastruktur, telefoni eller cloud er en fordel, men ikke et krav.     Samarbejde - internt og eksternt - er helt centralt i denne rolle, så du skal kunne lide at arbejde tæt sammen med andre. Du deler din viden, bruger kollegernes faglighed og siger til, når noget er svært. Det gør du undervejs, så teamet kan hjælpe med at finde en løsning.     Du får ikke et individuelt salgsbudget eller bonusordninger, så det skal du ikke være drevet af. Men hvis du i højere grad motiveres af at opbygge tillid, forstå kundernes forretning og skabe relationer, så passer netIP mere sandsynligt til dig. Her får du plads til at rådgive ud fra kundens behov og udvikle relationen over tid. Samtidig får du et job med indflydelse og stort udviklingspotentiale. title: Key Account Manager Kaffe – Lindbak Bergen
description: Vil du være med på neste steg i Lindbak Bergen?   Lindbak Bergen har vokst raskt de siste fem årene. Nå tar vi et nytt steg, og kaffe er et av områdene vi har store ambisjoner for fremover.  Derfor søker vi en  Key Account Manager Kaffe  som vil sørge for fornøyde kunder, gode kaffeopplevelser og videre vekst sammen med laget vårt.  De siste fem årene har Lindbak kjøpt eget kaffebrenneri og utviklet egne kaffetyper. Vi kjøper kaffe direkte fra kaffebonden, og med kontorer over hele Norge kan vi levere til både lokale bedrifter og kunder med nasjonale behov.  Vi ser etter deg som har erfaring med  B2B-salg , gjerne som KAM eller med ansvar for større bedriftskunder. Du liker å bygge relasjoner, møte nye mennesker og skape resultater. Og selvfølgelig må du like både å jobbe med kaffe og å drikke den!  Lytt gjerne til en tidligere podkast vi spilte inn for ca. 1 år siden på hvordan livet til en kaffeselger har vært:  https://feeds.acast.com/public/shows/neste-stopp-lindbak   Livet som kaffeselger i Lindbak Bergen. Vil du bli med på laget?       Om rollen:   Som KAM Kaffe får du  ansvar for å følge opp og utvikle hele kaffeporteføljen i Lindbak Bergen , i tillegg til eget salgsbudsjett for eksisterende og nye kunder.  Du skal ikke gjøre jobben alene. Sammen med gode kollegaer, salgssjef og daglig leder skal du skape fornøyde kunder, gode kaffeopplevelser og videre vekst. Din rolle er å ha oversikten og sørge for at  kundene blir godt fulgt opp gjennom hele tiden de er hos oss , fra den første koppen til nye behov og fornyelse av avtalen.  Du skal både utvikle eksisterende kunder og ønske nye kunder velkommen. Målet er at kundene våre skal få kaffe i verdensklasse på kontoret og oppleve at vi er en samarbeidspartner som bryr oss og følger opp.  En viktig del av rollen er også å  utvikle kaffekundene videre innen andre av Lindbaks forretningsområder . Du blir kjent med kundens behov, åpner dører og følger opp mulighetene sammen med riktig kollega. Du trenger ikke kunne eller selge alt selv, men du liker å se muligheter og skape gode løsninger sammen med andre.      Dine viktigste oppgaver:    Sørge for fornøyde kunder som får kaffe i verdensklasse på kontoret  Ha oversikt over hele kaffeporteføljen og sikre god oppfølging gjennom hele kundeforholdet  Utvikle eksisterende kunder og hjelpe nye kunder med å finne gode kaffeløsninger  Følge opp avtaler, fornyelser og endringer i kundenes behov  Utvikle kaffekundene innen andre av Lindbaks forretningsområder, sammen med kollegaene dine  Delta aktivt i nettverk, bygge relasjoner og skape nye muligheter  Utvikle og dele kunnskap om kaffe, kaffemaskiner og tjenestene våre   Levere på eget salgsbudsjett og bidra til at vi når budsjettet for kaffeområdet som helhet        Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi tror du:   har erfaring med B2B-salg, gjerne som KAM  liker å bygge langsiktige kunderelasjoner og vinne nye kunder  trives med tydelige mål, eget budsjett og ansvar  jobber strukturert og følger opp det du starter

Vos responsabilités        Vous encadrez, accompagnez et faites monter en compétences l'équipe service client existante vers de nouvelles méthodes de travail. Vous garantissez une expérience client irréprochable et prenez personnellement en charge les comptes clés ainsi que les situations sensibles. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.  Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.  The multi-faceted role you’ve been looking for… Managers play a vibrant, integral role at Huron. Their invaluable knowledge reflects in the projects they manage and the teams they lead. Known for being politically savvy, they build long-standing relationships with clients, while collaborating with colleagues to solve their most important challenges. They plan, shape and deliver technology solutions that deliver results and seamlessly align with client goals, visions and missions. Remarkably versatile, our Managers also spend significant time mentoring junior staff on the engagement team—where they tirelessly share expertise as well as feedback and encouragement. This benefits Huron profoundly as it promotes a culture of respect, unity, collaboration and personal achievement.  Our environment inspires and rewards growth… As a Manager, you have the unique ability to specialize in certain areas of enterprise software products that showcase and employ your areas of expertise while pursuing your “career vision”. Huron is big enough to offer the opportunity and exposure you need for your career growth—but small enough to give you individual attention for your professional development. Every Manager adds to who we are as an organization—and the more you evolve, the more we do. An exciting career experience awaits you where you’ll be challenged to discover your true potential: It’s analytically rigorous… it’s practical… it’s entrepreneurial… it’s intellectually stimulating—and most definitely—it’s career-defining. It’s the Huron way.  We see what’s possible in you and help you achieve it. title: Customer Success Manager
description: At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work.  We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.  Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven  Customer Success Manager  to join our Americas team.   What You’ll Be Doing   As a Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximize opportunities for our SMB customers and Semperis.  Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions.   You Will Be Responsible For     Designing success plans for a Book of Business of approximately 50 SMB customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upselling, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to help them reach their business objectives and operational goals.  You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets.  Acting as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs.  Leading training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations.  Monitoring record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalized customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc.  Developing and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.)  Identifying potential customer references and assisting with development of customer case studies.  Gain and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services.  In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program.     What You Wil

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: Who we are     Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.    Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.     About the role:   Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.   Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.    This role is a remote position open to candidates residing in Germany.   Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.    Will require travel to customer sites in Germany, The Netherlands and the United Kingdom, for up to 20% of the time, which may include overnight stays.    You should apply if:     You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether a customer achieves their sustainability goals, or whether power gets restored quickly after an incident   You thrive the most when solving problems:  Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.   You are a natural relationship builder:  Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.   You are the architect of your own career:  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to

description: Dich begeistern...      Traveltech in Luftfahrt & Hotellerie    Netzwerken & Kunden betreuen    Gestalten & Wachsen   ...dann bewirb dich jetzt als:     Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)     You decide. Bei Layover Solutions entscheidest du, wie du deine Ziele bestmöglich erreichst. Wir sind ein Frankfurter Startup und bieten unseren Kunden ( Hotels und Airlines ) eine digitale Lösung, bei der sich alles um den Flughafen dreht. Mit unserer Plattform unterstützen wir Airlines bei der Unterbringung gestrandeter Fluggäste. Hotels unterstützen wir dabei, die Buchungsprozesse effektiv zu gestalten.     Dein spannendes Aufgabenfeld:     Als Customer Success Manager baust du deinen Kundenstamm aus und stellst einen guten Überblick über den gesamten Customer-Lifecycle sicher:   Du baust dir einen Kundenstamm auf, betreust deine Kunden am Flughafen und stellst sicher, sie mit unserer Technologie erfolgreicher und zufriedener werden.  Du arbeitest in einem spannenden Umfeld, in dem mehrere Branchen aufeinandertreffen. Das Onboarding unserer Technologie bei neuen Partnern und Kunden gehört dabei zu deinen Aufgaben. Du begleitest den gesamten Prozess – von der Einführung und Schulung bis zur erfolgreichen Nutzung unserer Lösung.  Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Kunden und Partner unsere Technologie verstehen, effektiv einsetzen und langfristig erfolgreich damit arbeiten.  Du unterstützt aktiv bei Herausforderungen wie Flugausfällen.  Du hast das richtige Gespür dafür, was deine Kunden weiterbringt, und lieferst wertvollen Input für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologie.  Du beobachtest den Markt und führst gezielt Analysen durch.  Du kontrollierst den Umsatz in deinem Bereich und bringst eigene verkaufsfördernde Ideen mit.  Du bist ein Organisationstalent und führst eigene Marketingmaßnahmen für Neu- und Bestandskunden durch.  Du siehst Probleme als Chance: Reklamationen nimmst du auf und bearbeitest diese souverän.  Du arbeitest eng mit unseren internen Teams zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Kundenfeedback und neue Anforderungen schnell ihren Weg in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Lösung finden.      Das bringst Du mit :      Studium oder Ausbildung in der Airline-/Hotelbranche oder einem ähnlichen Bereich  Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung, bevorzugt in den Bereichen Account Management/Customer Service  Sprachkenntnisse – je mehr, desto besser! title: Corporate Traveler - Customer Success Manager - Boston, MA
description: Customer Success Manager    A world where tech and people work collectively to make corporate travel simpler, faster and easier.  Corporate Traveler is one of Flight Centre Travel Group’s (FCTG) most successful brands, globally. Our mission is to dominate the SME market, making the end-to-end travel experience faster, simpler and easier for our customers and to demonstrate ongoing value to decision-makers, travelers and bookers. We provide our customers with the perfect blend of personal, local service blended with our expert technology suite and the great choice and value which comes with being part of the FCTG family. To learn more about Corporate Traveler please click HERE   About The Opportunity   Corporate Traveler USA is looking for a commercially minded Customer Success Manager to own and grow a portfolio of valued customer accounts. title: Manager, Customer Service & Order Management - Food Industry
description: About Our Client:  Our client is a leading distributor of high-quality food products serving a diverse range of commercial and hospitality customers.       Position Scope:  This is a new role and a critical one in supporting our client’s growth. The Manager, Customer Service & Order Management owns the order desk end to end: approximately 20 people across day, night and weekend shifts, two shift leads, and the Pepper App, their wholesale customer ordering portal.      The order desk takes every order across both channels, wholesale and direct, handles the first customer question or complaint, and works directly with production, logistics and warehousing to get every order made and out the door on time. You will sit at the centre of Sales, Finance and Operations, with a direct line to the executive team.      We are looking for an up-and-coming leader with energy and ambition, someone who wants to shape a team and set a standard rather than simply inherit one. If you are ready to run something that matters, this is it.       This position is Monday to Friday, on site at their Etobicoke facility, with Saturday coverage as required.        Responsibilities:       Lead the team.  Coach and develop the order desk staff through the daytime and night and weekend shift leads. Hire, onboard and train. Set clear expectations and hold people to them. Build the next shift leads from within.    Staff the operation.  Own scheduling, coverage and attendance across six days and three shifts, matched to the shape of daily order volume.    Run the desk.  Own accurate, complete and on-time order entry across both channels. Manage the daily order deadlines and the handoff into production, logistics and warehousing so every order is cut, picked and routed on time. Work the exceptions directly: shorts, substitutions, custom specifications and same-day changes.    Own the customer experience.  The desk is the first point of contact for customer questions and complaints. Own the speed and quality of that response. Track complaints by root cause and take recurring issues back to the responsible team with the data.    Own the Pepper App.  Full ownership of the wholesale customer portal: roadmap and backlog, customer onboarding and training, and adoption targets that move order volume from phone and email onto the portal.    Establish and manage KPIs.  Build the desk's scorecard with the team, starting with order accuracy and orders per hour and extending to response times, on-time order release and Pepper order share.    Drive process improvement.  Own the desk's standard operating procedures and lead continuous improvement across a high-volume, custom-cut operation.    Lead the desk through SAP S/4HANA.  Represent the order desk through design, testing, training and go-live, and own the transition off their current order management system.        Qualifications and Experience:      5 or more years in customer service, order management, inside sales or operations,

title: Team Leader - Contact Centre
location: North Ryde, New South Wales, Australia
description: 38 hours a week, hours of operation 7am to 10 pm weekdays   At Healius, we're united by a shared purpose: making a difference to the future of Australia's health. There's never been a more exciting time to join us as we transform into a stronger, more agile organisation with a focus on innovative ways of working, excellent customer and patient experiences and being a great place to work.  This is an opportunity to shape a high-performing team that plays an important role in supporting healthcare professionals and patients across Australia. Joining Healius during a period of transformation, you'll be empowered to drive team success, influence positive change and help deliver exceptional customer experiences that make a meaningful impact.   About Us   Healius is one of Australia’s leading healthcare companies, committed to supporting quality, affordable and accessible healthcare for all Australians. Through our network of state-based and specialty brands, we provide high-quality diagnostic services that support clinicians to make informed decisions and improve patient outcomes.  With more than 80 medical laboratories and approximately 2,000 patient collection centres nationwide, we process approximately one in four Medicare-funded pathology tests each year, supporting services that extend from some of Australia’s largest and most complex private and public hospitals to regional areas and remote Indigenous communities.   About The Role   As a Customer Experience People Leader, you'll lead and develop a team of Customer Experience Specialists, fostering a culture of engagement, continuous improvement and service excellence. You'll play an important role in empowering your team to deliver exceptional customer experiences while supporting strong operational outcomes.  Key responsibilities:    Lead, coach and develop a team of Customer Experience Specialists and Senior Customer Experience Specialists  Manage team performance, engagement and development through regular people leadership activities  Monitor operational performance and allocate work to support service delivery objectives  Conduct quality assurance audits and provide timely coaching and feedback  Drive achievement of customer experience, quality and operational performance targets  Partner with Customer Experience Coaches to support capability development and training initiatives  Identify and implement continuous improvement and innovation opportunities  Collaborate with stakeholders to support change initiatives and deliver positive customer outcomes     About You   We're seeking an experienced people leader with demonstrated success developing high-performing teams and improving performance outcomes, ideally within a contact centre or customer service environment. You will bring a supportive leadership style, sound judgement and the ability to balance customer needs, operational priorities, quality standards and team engagement.   Qualifications And Experience     2+ years' leadership

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Who We’re Looking For  At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter. Our roles are designed for people who thrive on driving impact, see ambiguity as an opportunity, and believe that raising the bar is a team sport.  We don’t bring people in to run playbooks. We hire people who want to rewrite them. And in this role, you’ll get to do that, while shaping the future of managed services for our global partners. (That’s what we call our customers.)  What is ScalePad  At ScalePad, we’re building more than software; we’re building confidence and clarity for the people who manage the technology businesses rely on every day.  Our mission: help MSPs evolve into MVPs (their clients’ most valuable partner). Our tools turn them from reactive service providers into strategic advisors through a consistent, scalable Customer Success motion. Our product suite unifies risk insights, client planning, and service delivery so MSPs can have smarter conversations, show clients their value, and grow their revenue.  But our purpose goes beyond our software. We’re creating a workplace where curious, growth-minded people can do their best work, where ideas are valued, progress is shared, and everyone belongs. Together, we’re creating a future where MSPs don’t just keep businesses running, they help them thrive. We believe that when our partners succeed, we all do.  With offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and Phoenix and a global-first mindset. ScalePad has grown into a category leader trusted by 12,000+ partners across 60+ countries. We’ve been recognized for our products and corporate culture by MSP Today, G2, and Great Place to Work™, to name a few.   About The Role   Are you prepared to advance your career as a Customer Success Manager at ScalePad? As part of our Revenue team, you will manage a large portfolio of SMB partners and own the customer and commercial outcomes across the lifecycle. This includes retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, and customer satisfaction,  You will manage renewals from as early as 120 days before contract end through the contract end date, using sequencing, automations, and custom efforts to engage the right stakeholders and move each renewal forward. You will lead renewal business reviews, conduct focused discovery, navigate cancellation conversations, negotiate solutions, and identify growth opportunities to hand to and develop with the AE team.  This is a hands-on, commercially focused role for someone who can communicate with confidence, demonstrate products clearly, and connect customer needs to practical outcomes. title: Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Planning, Decision & Intercept
description:
Building autonomous supremacy systems in Berlin

Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. We design tightly integrated autonomy stacks in Europe to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces, focusing on defensive and counter-system capabilities including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions.

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer to build the intelligence that turns mission objectives, target information and vehicle state into executable autonomous behaviour.

Your mission with us

  • Build the autonomy layer of our high-speed aerial robotic systems.

  • Convert mission objectives, target state and vehicle state into real-time actions and trajectories.

  • Develop algorithms for dynamic rendezvous, pursuit, interception and terminal approach.

  • Build target-motion prediction and intercept-point estimation for moving airborne targets.

  • Develop real-time path planning, trajectory generation and replanning under uncertainty.

  • Account for aircraft capabilities, energy, maneuverability, sensing uncertainty and changing target behaviour.

  • Build decision and behaviour logic that allows the system to adapt continuously during a mission.

  • Combine classical robotics, optimization, MPC and learned approaches where appropriate.

  • Explore reinforcement learning, imitation learning and policy-based autonomy where they provide meaningful advantages.

  • Work closely with perception, estimation and control engineers to close the autonomy loop.

  • Take algorithms from simulation into real aircraft and validate them through repeated flight testing.

description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

title: Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer
description:
Our software decides every 15 minutes what a battery should do. You own the layer that makes it happen: our EMS, the interface between our optimizer and every battery we connect. Whether we build our own EMS or integrate existing ones is a call you'll help us make.

  • Own our EMS integration layer: one clean interface that connects any storage system (inverter, BMS, site controller) to our optimizer

  • Onboard new vendors over Modbus, MQTT and vendor APIs, so the next battery is a config, not a project

  • Commission systems on site until the battery follows the plan to the kW

  • Build our own edge box on standard hardware (think Raspberry Pi on a DIN rail)

You Will Have Fun If You Are

Builder with agency

  • Get-shit-done mentality: you'd rather drive to the site than wait for a support ticket

  • High ownership: the EMS interface is yours, from the vendor call to go-live

Mission-driven

  • Passionate about energy transition and climate impact

  • Thrive in early-stage chaos (e.g. "Can you be in Ingolstadt tomorrow at 8?")

You Won't Have Fun If You

  • Like to follow processes. We don't have any.

  • Want to work remotely. We're in the office 5 days/week, and regularly on site at customers.

  • Want to stay on one side of the wall. This is half software, half hardware.

🍊Our mission

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe.

We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027.

🍊About the role

The Data Architect owns assigned studies end-to-end, taking full responsibility for both the design of the database on Citrus and the quality of the data it produces, from study planning through database lock. The role designs with the final analysis in mind, writes code where manual review would slow delivery, and designs the edit checks and validation that prevent issues before they make their way downstream. The Data Architect is the technical and data lead for assigned studies and works with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Programme Directors, and Product to ensure each study captures the data its scientific objectives require.

title: Closer
description:
Chez nous, vendre, c'est coacher à la décision. 🎯

Nous sommes convaincus de trois choses :

  • Vous êtes là pour sincèrement aider la personne en face de vous.

  • Sa réussite se trouve souvent en dehors de sa zone de confort.

  • Pour obtenir des résultats différents, il faut oser faire les choses différemment.

Au sein de notre bureau d’études, en lien direct et quotidien avec la production, vous prenez en charge la conception électronique complète des cartes, de la schématique à l’industrialisation :

  • Analyse du besoin client et définition de l’architecture

  • Choix des composants selon les contraintes (techniques, mécaniques, CEM, industrialisation)

  • Maîtrise indispensable d’Altium Designer (schéma + routage)

  • Solides bases en électronique analogique et numérique

  • Expérience du choix de composants, de la gestion de nomenclature et de l’industrialisation

  • Un plus : notions de Solidworks, développement logiciel embarqué (C, microcontrôleurs)

  • Autonomie, rigueur, intérêt pour les produits techniques et compacts

Environnement technique

  • Logiciels : Altium Designer, Solidworks, Git

  • Composants : Microchip, STM32, drivers, convertisseurs, capteurs, modules RF…

  • Contraintes : température, humidité, vibrations, compacité, low energy, CEM

Conditions & Avantages

  • CDI, poste sur site, au plus près de la production : télétravail très limité

title: Freelance French SEO Content Writer

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Freelance French SEO Content Writer to strengthen our organic search visibility and AI

search presence across the French markets, including France and French-speaking Africa.

Our current French organic search visibility presents a significant growth opportunity. We are looking for a writer who can

create original, high-quality French content tailored to local audiences, search intent, and SEO best practices. This is a

content-writing role, not a translation role.

The successful candidate will help improve our visibility across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered

answer engines, including ChatGPT and similar platforms.

• Create high-quality French content pieces, based on briefs and keyword targets provided by the SEO team.

• Research relevant topics, industry trends, competitors, and audience needs to develop authoritative content.

• Adapt and localise existing English-language content for French-speaking markets while ensuring the content reads

naturally and is culturally relevant.

• Incorporate feedback from internal stakeholders and make revisions as required.

• Maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, content quality, and SEO guidelines.

Types of Content

• Commercial landing pages

• Blogs and thought-leadership articles

• Glossary and definition pages

• Whitepapers and long-form content

• Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

• Competitor comparison pages

We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own.

✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

About the team

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Employee Relations Consultant to join our People team. In this role, you will be pivotal in maintaining a fair, compliant, and positive work environment. You will manage end-to-end complex employee casework, drive continuous improvement across HR processes, refine key employment policies, and collaborate closely with our Compliance and Risk teams to support our firm’s enhanced regulatory status.

We're looking for an Employee Relations Consultant to join Marshmallow's People team for an initial three-month engagement, with the possibility of extending to six months depending on caseload. We're open to either a fixed-term contract or a day-rate consultancy arrangement.

title: Lead Analytics Engineer - Finance Data (FinOps)
description:
About Finom
Finom is growing fast, and Finance needs data that grows with it. As our Lead Analytics Engineer for Finance, you'll be the data partner for treasury, reconciliation and accounting. You'll also support our corporate finance and investor reporting work together with the team's existing data partner. You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work

This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data

What You Will Be Doing
- Partner with the Treasury, Reconciliation and Accounting teams on their processes, priorities and how data supports them.
- Build out treasury data: positions, cash flows and liquidity, as trusted data products the team can rely on day to day.
- Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand.
- Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work.
- Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions.
- Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them.
- Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses.
- Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work.
- Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value.

title: QA & Authorisation Handler
description:
Turning risk into opportunity

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.


What we are looking for

We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team.

title: Business Service Manager (Open for Local Nationals Only)
description: Description   CIMMYT is a cutting-edge, non-profit, international organization dedicated to solving tomorrow’s problems today. It is entrusted with fostering improved quantity, quality, and dependability of production systems and basic cereals such as maize, wheat, triticale, sorghum, millets, and associated crops through applied agricultural science, particularly in the Global South, through building strong partnerships. This combination enhances the livelihood trajectories and resilience of millions of resource-poor farmers, while working towards a more productive, inclusive, and resilient agrifood system within planetary boundaries. CIMMYT is a core CGIAR Research Center, a global research partnership for a food-secure future, dedicated to reducing poverty, enhancing food and nutrition security, and improving natural resources. For more information, visit cimmyt.org.  We are looking for a driven, service-oriented professional to join us as Business Services Manager at CIMMYT Bangladesh. This role sits at CIMMYT Bangladesh. CIMMYT operates a network of research stations across Bangladesh, each with its own inventory, warehousing, and field operations requirements.  The position is based in Bangladesh with frequent travel to research stations and CIMMYT operational locations.   Specific Duties    General Business Services Management     Lead and coordinate business services operations across both CIMMYT Bangladesh, keeping everything aligned with institutional policies and compliance standards.  Ensure operational services are delivered efficiently across field stations, offices, warehouses, and research operations.  Build processes that are structured, scalable, and consistent with CIMMYT’s internal control frameworks and regional direction.  Work closely with the RBSM – Asia on operational planning, escalation, and decision support — keeping them well-informed with timely updates and field observations.  Spot operational bottlenecks early and put practical solutions in place to improve efficiency, compliance, and service quality.  Track and maintain performance indicators across inventory, warehousing, procurement, logistics, facilities, and admin services.     Inventory, Warehouse, and Field Operations     This is a significant part of the role. CIMMYT’s research stations carry diverse and operationally critical inventory, and effective management of these assets is essential to the success of research programmes.  Oversee inventory and warehouse management across CIMMYT locations in Bangladesh.  Maintain strong controls over seed inventory, agrochemicals and fertilizers, fuel and consumables, and harvested produce and agricultural by-products.  Ensure warehouses are well-organized, with clear zoning, storage standards, stock movement controls, and regular physical verification.  Keep inventory traceable through proper documentation, batch tracking, and reconciliation processes.  Support the rollout and ongoing use of Microsoft Dynamics 36

title: Head of Compliance
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build

title: Model Risk Officer
description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

About VIA HealthTech

VIA turns a therapy session into a finished session note, and session notes into a complete psychological report. That is work which used to cost therapists hours every week.

We are the market leading AI assistant for psychotherapists. Over 4,000 psychotherapists across the DACH region use VIA every day, and we process hundreds of thousands of sessions per month. We are ISO 27001:2022 certified and hold a BSI C5 attestation.

We are a multidisciplinary team of 12 in Berlin-Mitte. Being the market leader in AI documentation is our starting position, not our goal. We are going much deeper, into the therapeutic process itself and into how a practice is run, with products that will be regulated as medical devices under EU MDR.

The role

We are 12 today and plan to roughly double in the next year, across engineering, our clinical team and go-to-market. We are bootstrapped. Every salary is paid from revenue, not from a funding round, and a wrong hire costs us a year we cannot buy back. We cannot afford that mistake, so we do not hire good. We hire exceptional.

Today, hiring lands between three founder calendars that are already full, or with agencies. Both fill roles. Neither builds anything that stays. We would rather internalise it: one person who knows our bar, owns the whole pipeline and builds the people function around it. You are not joining an HR team. You are becoming it.

Recruiting is the core of this role, and the measure in year one is simple: every role we open, filled on time with someone excellent, closed by you. Everything else in HR is yours to build lean behind that.

What you'll own

  • The whole funnel, for every role. Briefing with the hiring founder, the job ad, sourcing, screening, interview loops, references, offer, close. You are the first conversation a candidate has with VIA, and the one who gets them over the line

title: Agent Security Engineer
description:
Belmont Lavan is hiring an Agent Security Engineer to secure autonomous AI agents before and after they reach production. Agents now call tools, hold credentials and act on live systems, so they need the controls we already expect for people and services: identity, least-privilege access, monitoring and testing.

You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning
  • Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management
  • Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust
  • Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar)
  • Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives

title: Senior Executive Assistant (PSA-3)
description:
United Nations University (UNU)

The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organization within the United Nations System. UNU engages in policy-relevant research, capacity development, and knowledge dissemination in furtherance of the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The work of UNU contributes to solving pressing global problems that are the concern of the United Nations and its Member States. 

For the past five decades, UNU has been a source of impartial research on sustainability, human security, and economic development. With hundreds of researchers working at institutes in 12 countries, UNU's expertise spans the full breadth of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, generating policy-relevant knowledge to effect positive global change. UNU collaborates closely with other UN entities and leading research institutions across the globe. For more information, please visit http://unu.edu.

The United Nations University Vice-Rectorate in Europe (UNU-VIE), established in 2007 in Bonn, Germany, is one of two UNU Vice-Rectorates and the only one located in Europe. It supports the institutional development of UNU, facilitates collaboration across UNU and the UN, as well as fosters strategic partnerships - particularly with the Global South - and shares knowledge and expertise through the development of joint activities and projects. In addition, UNU-VIE conducts frontier research reinforcing existing UNU programming and supporting the implementation of key UN priorities. More information about UNU-VIE can be found here: https://unu.edu/vie.

title: Kodierfachkraft / Medizincontroller:in Psychiatrie (PEPP) – Remote (w/m/d)
description:
Über Valova

Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser, die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Dein PEPP-Wissen: nicht für eine Klinik, sondern für viele. Du kennst die DKR-Psych im Detail, weißt, wo im Klinikalltag Erlöse verloren gehen, und hast schon mit dem MD über Fälle diskutiert? Bei Valova sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere KI so gut kodiert wie Du, und bringst sie in psychiatrische und psychosomatische Kliniken in ganz Deutschland.

Die Kodierung in Psychiatrie und Psychosomatik folgt eigenen Regeln. Therapieeinheiten, ergänzende Tagesentgelte, Fallzusammenführungen und Personalvorgaben machen PEPP zu einem der anspruchsvollsten Systeme im Krankenhaus, und jede Lücke in Dokumentation oder Kodierung kostet Erlöse und führt zu MD-Prüfungen. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software PEPP so gut versteht wie die besten Kodierfachkräfte. Genau dafür brauchen wir Dich.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in Fällen, die vollständig kodiert sind und in der Prüfung bestehen, in weniger Streit mit dem MD und in Stunden, die Kodierteams und Therapeut:innen zurückgewinnen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Valova PEPP beibringen: Du übersetzt ICD-10-GM, OPS Kapitel 9, DKR-Psych, PEPP-Katalog und PsychPV/PPP-RL in klare Kodierregeln, Plausibilitätsprüfungen und Testfälle, inklusive Therapieeinheiten, ergänzender Tagesentgelte und Fallzusammenführungen.

  • KI-Vorschläge prüfen: Du bewertest die Kodiervorschläge von Valova und markierst, was stimmt und was nicht. So wird die Qualität messbar besser.

We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. title: Manager of Customer Success, Activation
description: Join Our Team at RealWork      We’re  RealWork , a team of builders and problem-solvers based in Austin, TX. Our mission is to help home service professionals earn the trust they deserve online.      RealWork  is the marketing engine behind thousands of contractors nationwide. We transform their best jobs into SEO-optimized stories, photos, and reviews that drive growth. Through integrations with leading field service platforms, we automate meaningful customer engagement after each job and use job content to help contractor’s online presence better reflect the quality of their work in the field.      RealWork  is based 100% in the USA and headquartered in Austin, TX.      The Role   The first 90 days decide whether a new customer sticks with RealWork. Our Activation team owns that window: onboarding new accounts, getting them set up and using the product, and handling inbound calls and emails along the way.     As Manager, you will lead this team and own its results on activation and early retention. This is a player-coach role: most of your time goes to coaching and developing the team and improving how we onboard customers, and you will step in on customer calls and escalations when needed. This is a full-time role based in our Austin office, five days a week.      What you'll do    Lead and coach the team    Manage daily operations, including workload, scheduling and call coverage, and run one-on-ones and team meetings.  Hire, onboard and train Activation Specialists, and maintain training materials and process documentation.  Review live and recorded Zoom meetings, calls and emails, audit account work against our process standards, and give specialists specific feedback.  Act as the escalation point for complex customer issues, and cover calls for specialists who are out.    Own performance    Track team and individual KPIs, including activation rate, early churn, product adoption and call activity.  Report on trends, root causes and actions to Customer Success leadership.  Use data to find at-risk accounts early and make sure the team acts on them.    Improve the process, including with AI    Find friction in onboarding, test fixes and measure whether they worked. Partner across the company    Give Sales structured feedback on handoff quality and patterns in accounts that struggle to activate.  Bring product feedback, bugs and feature requests from new customers to Product and Engineering.  Work with Implementation, Support & Retention so customers move smoothly from onboarding into their long-term relationship with RealWork.       What you bring    At least 1 year of experience managing people as a manager, supervisor or team lead.
