title: Google & YouTube Ads Specialist - Ecommerce (Remote, Full-time) - Asia
description:
Headquarters:  Remote
      URL:   http://convertibles.dev 
 

 
  About us   Convertibles is a CRO and Shopify development agency for 8 and 9 figure D2C brands. We've just brought Google and YouTube ads in-house under the same roof, run by our co-founder Clay. He's been doing Google Ads for ecommerce since 2013: built and exited his own brand on Google Ads and CRO, then ran Google and YouTube for brands spending $50k to $500k+ a month on Google alone. The ads book today is around seven brands across the US, UK, EU and Australia, and it's growing.   The role   This is an apprenticeship with a real job attached. You work directly with Clay (x @ecomclay), learn how he runs accounts, and within 90 days you're running the weekly cycle on your first accounts yourself.  The weekly cycle, concretely:   Monday: pull last week's numbers (Google Ads platform side plus the client's attribution tool - Triple Whale, Converge or Northbeam), update the reporting workbook, write the client update, produce the actions list. Exact campaign, exact change, why.  Through the week: make the changes, watch pacing, check feeds and Merchant Center, build new campaigns (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube / Demand Gen).  Client calls: sit in first, then run them.    How we work, so you know what you're signing up for    YouTube and Demand Gen are the main event, not a side channel. We take a brand's winning Meta ads, recut them for YouTube, and scale. Accounts have gone from YouTube at 6-12% of media mix to 13-22%, at a return that held for over a year.  Attribution-tool numbers decide YouTube, not platform numbers. If you've only ever judged campaigns on what Google Ads says, you'll learn a different lens.  Everything gets a number. "Performance improved" is not a finding. "NC-CPA went from £38 to £30 on the same spend" is.  AI is part of the workflow. Reporting workbooks, data pulls and first drafts are built with Claude. You don't need to be a developer, but you need to be comfortable working this way.  There's a dev, CRO, QA and design team behind the ads. When a landing page or a feed needs fixing, someone fixes it.    Who fits    2-4 years hands-on in Google Ads for ecommerce. Your hands on the account, not managing someone whose hands are.  You've run Search, Shopping and PMax on real budgets (at least one account at $20k+/month). You've at least touched YouTube or Demand Gen and want to go deep on it.  Comfortable in Google Sheets / Excel. You can look at eight weeks of campaign data and tell me what changed and why.  You know what a Merchant Center disapproval is and how to fix it.  You write clearly in English. You'll be writing to clients by week five.  Curious, direct, not precious about being told you're wrong.   Not a fit: agency account managers who relay what the specialist did. Meta buyers who "also do Google". Anyone who needs the basics explained.   Hours   Full-time, 40h/wk. Your morning overlaps with Clay (he's UTC+8), your afternoon overlaps with UK

title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description: Wir finden jeden Tag die besten Talente für andere. Jetzt haben wir hier eine interne Stelle zu besetzen. Rocken® hat das Recruiting in der Schweiz neu gedacht, mit eigenen Plattformen, smartem Matching und einem Team, das für seine Arbeit brennt. Wenn Du das mitprägen willst, bist Du bei uns richtig.   Rolle   Unser Auftraggeber ist ein etabliertes, international ausgerichtetes Industrieunternehmen mit Schwerpunkt auf technisch anspruchsvollen Produkten und kundenspezifischen Lösungen für den Maschinen- und Anlagenbau. Das Unternehmen überzeugt durch hohe Innovationskraft, technische Kompetenz und eine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung. Identifikation und Realisierung von Markt- und Wachstumspotenzialen.  Erarbeitung kundenspezifischer Lösungsansätze in Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Fachbereichen.  Eigenständige Führung von Preis-, Vertrags- und Konditionsverhandlungen.  Steuerung komplexer Vertriebs- und Kundenprojekte über den gesamten Verkaufsprozess.  Erstellung und Umsetzung strategischer Account-Pläne.  Analyse von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Kundenentwicklungen.  Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Produktion, Product Management und weiteren internen Stakeholdern.  Repräsentation des Unternehmens bei Kundenbesuchen, Fachveranstaltungen und Messen.     Qualifikationen     Technische oder kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung.  Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Key Account Management oder technischen B2B-Vertrieb.  Nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau und der Entwicklung langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen.  Erfahrung im Vertrieb von erklärungsbedürftigen technischen Produkten, Lösungen oder Investitionsgütern. Strukturierte, selbstständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise.  Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.  Internationale Reisebereitschaft. title: Global Relationship Manager
description: Corporate banking relationship management role covering leading multinational clients in Japan   Your new company     Join a leading global financial institution with a strong presence in Japan and an extensive international banking network. The firm supports major multinational corporations with financing, transaction banking, markets, and other corporate banking solutions.      Your new role       Manage and develop relationships with large multinational corporate clients across a range of industries  Drive revenue growth and increase wallet share by identifying new opportunities across corporate banking products  Partner with product specialists and international relationship teams to deliver tailored banking solutions  Manage credit quality, client requirements, and internal stakeholders while developing trusted relationships with senior decision-makers     What you'll need to succeed       Proven corporate banking or relationship management experience covering large corporate or multinational clients  Strong knowledge of credit and lending, cash management, trade finance, and markets products  Strong credit analysis, financial assessment, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities  Business-level fluency in both Japanese and English with excellent client-facing communication skills     What you'll get in return       Opportunity to manage relationships with major multinational corporations operating across global markets  Broad exposure to corporate lending, transaction banking, trade finance, and markets solutions  Work closely with international bankers and product specialists across a highly connected global network  Develop your career in a senior client-facing role within a leading international financial institution     What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.

title: Account Manager
description: Streamhub  is a total analytics platform powering total audience measurement, planning and targeting for TV / CTV, audio and streaming services. Our mission - make audience data actionable and accessible across the entire media ecosystem. We work with broadcasters, platforms and advertising agencies across multiple countries, combining advanced analytics, AI-driven insights and expert engineering to solve complex problems across the media and advertising value chain.  We are growing our business in Asia driven out of Tokyo, looking for those wanting to work in a B2B media & data tech startup environment.   The Opportunity  As our Account Manager, you’ll work at the intersection where the industry, product and technology meet, helping customers get the most from the platform to improve their everyday operations, whilst providing intelligence from the frontline to improve our service.  The role combines ownership of a portfolio of accounts with identifying opportunities to improve how customers and our team work. You’ll stay close to customers’ day-to-day needs, run discovery sessions and help shape solutions that support their business objectives. You’ll also explore how AI and automation can add value to customer and internal workflows, working with our technical teams to put suitable solutions into practice.  You’ll report to the Country Manager and work in close partnership with product and engineering, acting as a key point of contact for clients and supporting business opportunities across Japan and the broader APAC region.   What You’ll Be Doing       Account Ownership & Customer Discovery     Own the relationship for a portfolio of accounts, leading discussions that go beyond surface-level feature requests  Run innovation workshops with partners and clients, demonstrating what Streamhub products can unlock for their measurement and analytics challenges including AI  Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and partners in Japan and APAC  Translate customer business and data requirements into clear, actionable briefs for product and engineering  Build lasting relationships that create trust, reduce churn and open doors to expanded partnerships  Demonstrate Streamhub’s platform to new potential customers adapting the presentation to their needs  Develop proposals that clearly articulate Streamhub’s value proposition relative to customer objectives  Share customer and product knowledge to improve how Streamhub engages with its accounts to retain accounts  Support pre sales with your knowledge     AI & Workflow Improvement     Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve customer reporting, analytics and internal sales, marketing and delivery workflows.  Work with product and engineering teams to assess customer needs and coordinate suitable solutions.  Help customers understand and adopt relevant AI-powered features and tools.  Evaluate emerging AI tools and determine where they create genuine leverage

title: Key Account Manager - Food Service
description: SITAF Food, a premium food importer and distributor serving the HoReCa and retail sectors, is looking for a  Key Account Manager  to strengthen its commercial team and develop long-term partnerships with strategic foodservice customers.      Scope of Position:   The Key Account Manager will manage a portfolio of high-value, structured accounts, each generating at least SAR 8 million in annual revenue. The role involves building relationships with multiple stakeholders and positioning SITAF as a preferred partner within customers’ menu development cycles, procurement processes, and long-term business plans.      Key Responsibilities:    Build and maintain strong relationships with business owners, procurement teams, corporate chefs, and restaurant chefs.  Anticipate menu changes and product requirements, developing tailored solutions that position SITAF as the preferred supply partner.  Lead senior-level customer meetings and monthly business reviews, coordinating with the Sales Leadership Team on account performance, opportunities, and action plans.  Introduce new products and drive their adoption into customers’ regular purchasing portfolios.  Develop and execute strategic account plans with a one- to two-year horizon.  Collaborate closely with Field Sales Representatives to ensure consistent execution and service across customer locations.  Gather, maintain, and regularly update account and stakeholder information in the customer master database.  Prepare and maintain rolling forecasts by account and item, coordinating with internal teams to support product availability and demand planning.  Take ownership of receivables follow-up, working closely with customers and Finance to ensure timely collection.       Qualifications & Skills:    At least five years of experience in key account management or foodservice sales.  Proven ability to manage strategic accounts and build relationships with multiple senior stakeholders.  Strong understanding of foodservice operations, procurement processes, and menu planning cycles.  Excellent account planning, negotiation, relationship-building, and presentation skills.  Strong financial acumen, with the ability to assess account profitability and prepare reliable sales forecasts.  Ability to coordinate across internal teams and translate account strategies into effective local execution.  Very good English, both written and spoken.

title: Key Account Manager
description: Key Account Manager – FMCG   Company:  Baazeem Trading Company   Location:  Dammam, Saudi Arabia   Employment Type:  Full-Time   Industry:  FMCG – Trading & Distribution     Job Description  Baazeem Trading Company is seeking an experienced and results-driven  Key Account Manager  to manage and grow our key accounts business in the Eastern Region.  The ideal candidate will have a strong background in FMCG distribution, modern trade operations, customer negotiations, and commercial performance management.  Key Responsibilities   Develop and execute key account strategies to achieve sales, revenue, and profitability targets.  Manage relationships with major modern trade customers and key retail chains.  Lead annual business negotiations, commercial agreements, promotional plans, and joint business planning (JBP).  Monitor sales performance, trade spending, customer profitability, and collections.  Identify business growth opportunities and improve market share.  Ensure effective execution of promotional activities, product availability, and merchandising standards.  Collaborate with sales, supply chain, finance, and category management teams.  Prepare sales forecasts, account performance reports, and business reviews.      Requirements   Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.  Minimum 5 years of FMCG sales experience, including at least 3 years in Key Account Management.  Proven experience managing modern trade accounts and major retail chains.  Strong knowledge of the Eastern Region FMCG market.  Demonstrated success in customer negotiations, revenue growth, and profitability management.  Strong analytical, negotiation, and relationship management skills.  Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and sales reporting.  Good command of English.      Preferred Qualifications   Experience with national and regional modern trade chains.  Existing professional relationships with key retail customers in the Eastern Region.  Experience managing trade promotions, customer budgets, and commercial agreements.      How to Apply  Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn with an updated CV.

title: Account Manager - Last Mile Delivery and Urban Mobility
description: GRUPO BNP PARIBAS   El Grupo BNP Paribas es el principal banco de la Unión Europea y uno de los más importantes a nivel internacional. Contamos con cerca de 185.000 empleados en 65 países. En España somos más de 5.100 empleados en 13 líneas de negocio.   ARVAL   En Arval tenemos como misión mejorar la vida de las personas ofreciendo servicios de movilidad adaptados a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y con una clara orientación hacia la movilidad sostenible. Ofrecemos una amplia gama de soluciones innovadoras y proporcionamos un servicio personalizado a nuestros clientes, desde grandes corporaciones a particulares. Con más de 30 años de experiencia, presencia en treinta países y una flota financiada superior a 1,5 millones de vehículos, somos líderes en nuestro sector   SOBRE EL PUESTO   MISIÓN  Impulsar el crecimiento y la fidelización de clientes de última milla mediante una gestión consultiva, soluciones de movilidad competitivas y una coordinación eficaz con equipos internos para ofrecer un servicio diferencial y de alto valor.  Acompañar diariamente a los líderes de la última milla en la construcción de una movilidad urbana más inteligente y sostenible, guiando su transformación con visión estratégica, innovación y una experiencia de cliente excepcional.  RESPONSABILIDADES    Gestionar desde inicio hasta fin el proceso de asset transfer de vehículos provenientes de la competencia.  Liderar la colaboración con todos los miembros de la Last Mile Delivery Business Unit asegurando diariamente la voz del cliente, defendiendo sus necesidades y prioridades.  Seguimiento exhaustivo de vehículos “on the road” para mejorar KPI pactado con el cliente.  Gestión de incidencias asegurando una resolución ágil reduciendo el impacto en la operativa del cliente.  Impulso de proyectos de mejora continua identificando oportunidades de crecimiento.  Apoyo constante a la planificación y comités estratégicos, ayudando a preparar las reuniones mensuales con datos y visión estratégica.  Gestionar el ciclo de vida de la flota supervisando entregas, renovaciones y fines de contrato con foco en la disponibilidad y continuidad operativa.     REQUISITOS    Estudios     Mínimo Grado medio    Experiencia     Gestión y fidelización de clientes.  Preferencia: conocimiento en sector renting o logístico, última milla, distribución de mercancías.    Idiomas     Inglés alto (Imprescindible)  COMPETENCIAS    Técnicas     Excel alto (imprescindible)    Transversales & Comportamentales       Orientación al cliente  Capacidad de resolución de problemas  Negociación     BENEFICIOS      Programas de formación, planes de carrera y oportunidades de movilidad interna, no solo a nivel nacional sino también a nivel internacional gracias a nuestra presencia en diferentes países.   Comité de Diversidad e Inclusión a nivel Grupo que vela por un ambiente de trabajo inclusivo. En los últimos años se han creado varias comunidades de empleados que organizan diferentes acciones de concie

title: Account Manager Emilia Romagna
description: Il Committente è un'azienda italiana solida e strutturata, operante nel settore della distribuzione di materie plastiche per l'industria manifatturiera.  L'azienda opera in un contesto internazionale, collaborando con importanti realtà industriali e commerciali e servendo una clientela diversificata attraverso un'offerta articolata di prodotti e soluzioni tecniche.  Caratterizzata da una forte attenzione alla qualità del servizio, alla competenza tecnica e alla relazione con il cliente, si distingue per un approccio dinamico e attento alla crescita delle persone.  La sede centrale è a Padova.      Posizione   Per il Committente stiamo ricercando un/a Account Manager per la regione Emilia Romagna.  Riporterà al Country Manager Italia e avrà un ruolo strategico nello sviluppo e nella gestione del portafoglio clienti, al fine di consolidare le relazioni commerciali esistenti ed acquisire nuove opportunità di business.      Responsabilità principali    gestire e sviluppare il portafoglio clienti sul territorio di competenza (Emilia Romagna);  collaborare con tecnici ingegneri e Product Manager specialisti dei materiali plastici nonché con i Regional Sales Manager e con il Customer Service per garantire che le esigenze dei clienti vengano di volta in volta soddisfatte;  predisporre e aggiornare la reportistica commerciale.       Requisiti     residenza in Emilia-Romagna;    esperienza pregressa in ruoli commerciali B2B;   conoscenza del settore materie plastiche e preferibile esperienza nella vendita di materiali plastici;  buona conoscenza del gestionale Business Central di Microsoft per attività di reporting;  conoscenza scritta e parlata della lingua inglese (min. B2);  laurea in discipline economiche o affini;  spiccate capacità relazionali, negoziali, comunicative ed organizzative;  orientamento al risultato e autonomia nella gestione del lavoro;  disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio nazionale ed internazionale;  possesso di patente B.       Altre Informazioni   E' previsto un programma di onboarding.  Saranno messi a disposizione un’autovettura aziendale e i dispositivi necessari allo svolgimento delle mansioni (PC portatile, smartphone).     Orario di lavoro: full-time, da lunedì al venerdì, su giornata  Organizzazione dell'attività: 4 giorni settimanali dedicati alle attività sul territorio e 1 giornata in presenza presso la sede aziendale padovana  Tipologia contrattuale: contratto di lavoro subordinato a tempo indeterminato con iniziale periodo di prova  CCNL applicato: Commercio – Terziario  RAL: compresa tra €35.000-€45.000      La ricerca è rivolta ai candidati di ogni identità di genere (L.903/77). Ti preghiamo di leggere l'informativa sulla privacy ai sensi dell'art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 sulla protezione dei dati (GDPR) sul sito https://www.plasticsacademy.it/privacy-policy/

title: E-commerce & Self-service Manager
description: Vill du leda nästa steg i Tres digitala utveckling?    På Tre befinner vi oss mitt i en spännande förändringsresa där vi utvecklar våra digitala kanaler, arbetssätt och kundupplevelser för framtiden. Nu söker vi en  E-commerce & Self-service Manager  som vill vara med och driva den utvecklingen framåt.  Här får du möjlighet att kombinera ledarskap, affärsutveckling och digital transformation i en roll med stort inflytande över hur vi arbetar, prioriterar och utvecklar våra digitala kundupplevelser framåt.   Om rollen   Som E-commerce & Self-service Manager ansvarar du för utvecklingen av några av Tres viktigaste digitala kund- och försäljningskanaler. Du leder ett team bestående av Product Owners och Designers och skapar förutsättningarna för att teamet ska lyckas, både idag och på längre sikt.  Du blir en del av vårt Online Consumer Market-team och arbetar nära IT, kommersiella funktioner och andra delar av verksamheten för att säkerställa att vi fokuserar på det som skapar störst värde för kunderna och affären.  Rollen kombinerar ledarskap, affärsutveckling och strategisk utveckling. Vi söker dig som tycker om att skapa struktur där det saknas, sätta riktning i förändring och omsätta idéer till konkreta resultat.   I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att     Leda, coacha och utveckla ett team av Product Owners och Designers   Skapa tydlig riktning, struktur och prioriteringar för teamets arbete   Driva utvecklingen av digital försäljning, kundupplevelse och självservice   Säkerställa effektiv samverkan mellan affär, IT och andra delar av organisationen   Ansvara för mål, KPI:er och uppföljning inom området   Driva förändrings- och transformationsinitiativ från idé till genomförande   Utveckla arbetssätt, processer och samarbetsformer   Stötta teamet i komplexa frågeställningar och bidra med vägledning när nya arbetssätt eller lösningar behöver etableras      Olof beskriver sitt ledarskap    "Jag leder med energi, tydlighet och ett starkt fokus på samarbete och resultat. För mig är det viktigt att skapa en tydlig riktning genom strategi, vision och mål, och samtidigt ge teamet förutsättningar och mandat att omsätta dem i handling. Jag vill bygga starka och högpresterande team där människor utvecklar varandra, delar kunskap och vågar utmana, testa och lära."  ,   Du Kan Se Fram Emot Att     Vara en del av Tres digitala transformation   Komma in i ett skede där du har möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt, prioriteringar och framtida lösningar   Arbeta nära affär, teknik, analys och design   Ha stor påverkan på prioriteringar, arbetssätt och framtida lösningar   Bidra till att utveckla framtidens digitala kundupplevelser      Mer om dig    Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av ledarskap inom digital utveckling och som trivs i miljöer där affär, teknik och kundupplevelse möts. Du tycker om att utveckla både människor och verksamhet och har förmågan att skapa engagemang och framdrift när förutsättningarna förändras.   Vi Tror Att Du     Har flera

title: Leder til Proactive Execution
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Job Description   Vil du lede et team, der skaber værdiskabende kundedialoger på tværs af Danske Bank? I Proactive Execution er du med til at styrke den proaktive kontakt til kunderne og omsætte bankens mål til konkret værdi. Du får en rolle, hvor ledelse, samarbejde og forretningsforståelse går hånd i hånd.   Dine opgaver   Du bliver en del af Proactive Execution i København, tæt på Danske Banks nye domicil. Afdelingen består af cirka 70 kollegaer og ledere fordelt på flere teams, som arbejder tæt sammen med Advisory Network og Customer Engagement. Sammen skaber I flere, dybere og mere effektive kundeinteraktioner og sikrer en god overgang fra første kontakt til rådgivning. Du leder et team på 10-15 medarbejdere og bliver en vigtig del af lederfællesskabet.    Leder og udvikler dit team med tydelig retning og nærværende opfølgning.  Skaber fremdrift på KPI’er med fokus på både kvalitet og effekt.  Styrker samarbejdet med Advisory Network og Customer Engagement.  Understøtter gode kundeoplevelser gennem målrettet og relevant kundedialog.  Bidrager til struktur, læring og forbedringer i den daglige drift.     Om dig    Det forventer vi, du kan:     Du har enten erfaring med ledelse eller et stærkt ønske om at udvikle dig som leder, og du trives med at følge op på mål, resultater og udvikling.   Du forstår, hvad der skaber værdifuld kundedialog.   Du er god til at skabe retning og følge op på aftaler.  Du samarbejder klart og konstruktivt på tværs af teams.  Du har erfaring med forandringer, gerne med ADKAR eller lignende værktøjer.    Det er en fordel, hvis du kender til rådgivningsmiljøer, proaktiv kundekontakt eller større kommercielle organisationer. Det vigtigste er, at du kan omsætte mål til handling gennem mennesker.   Hvad vi tilbyder dig   Du bliver en del af en afdeling med stærke relationer, høj faglighed og plads til både alvor og et godt grin. Du får gode muligheder for at udvikle dig som leder og opbygge et bredt netværk på tværs af Danske Bank.   Er du klar til næste skridt?   Hvis rollen lyder som et sted, hvor du kan bruge din ledelse til at skabe værdi for både kunder, kollegaer og forretningen, vil vi gerne høre fra dig. Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte Allan Feddersen, Head of Proactive Execution, på +45 41950128.  Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Client Success Manager - iRute Travel
description: Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.  In Wilhelmsen Ship Management, our people don’t just hold jobs here. They make innovative ideas a reality and, in the process, shape the maritime industry. With a global network and a strong presence in ship management, we deliver services and solutions that support the safe, efficient, and sustainable operation of vessels worldwide. Through our iRute Travel Services, we help corporate and marine clients navigate their travel needs with technology-driven solutions and dedicated travel management expertise. You will serve as a trusted partner to clients, ensuring they are equipped to effectively use travel booking platforms, technology solutions, and travel policies while delivering a seamless and efficient travel management experience.    Who you report to    You will report to the General Manager of iRute Travel, working closely with clients and internal teams to ensure successful implementation and adoption of corporate and marine travel management services.    What you’ll do    You will play a key role in helping clients get the most out of iRute Travel’s technology and services to get the most value from their travel spend. You will lead client onboarding, drive user adoption, and build strong relationships with stakeholders to deliver an excellent travel management experience.   Your responsibilities will include:    Lead the end-to-end onboarding and implementation of travel management technologies and services for corporate and marine clients.     Develop and manage onboarding plans, project timelines, and implementation milestones.     Conduct training sessions for travel bookers, travellers, approvers, and client administrators on booking platforms, reporting tools, and service processes.     Guide clients on travel policy implementation, configuration, and compliance.     Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the onboarding and post-implementation journey.     Monitor client adoption, satisfaction, and travel programme performance, ensuring alignment with travel budgets and business objectives.     Manage client concerns and escalations, working closely with internal operations, technology, product, and service delivery teams.     Identify opportunities to improve client experience, service delivery, and operational efficiency.     Prepare onboarding reports, track implementation outcomes, and support continuous improvement initiatives. title: CRM & Client Development Manager
description: Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries under the PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s, and Car Shoe brands, and employs people of over 100 nationalities. Ottimizzare la conversione lungo l'intero percorso, riducendo gli abbandoni e l'incidenza di carte attivate che non vengono successivamente ricaricate e utilizzate.   Adozione e utilizzo continuativo:  sviluppare strategie che trasformino il primo utilizzo in azioni ricorrenti, rendendo la carta una scelta naturale per le spese di mobilità. Favorire le ricariche successive, la ripetizione degli acquisti e il mantenimento dell'utilizzo anche dopo gli incentivi iniziali.  Collaborare con HR, Welfare e People Manager delle aziende clienti per definire e implementare piani di lancio e diffusione, coordinando comunicazioni, strumenti digitali e iniziative on-site con il Promoter. Misurare la copertura dei dipendenti raggiunti e distinguere le barriere di comunicazione da quelle di attivazione, ricarica e utilizzo.  Progettare ed eseguire iniziative di CRM e marketing automation, con segmentazioni e percorsi differenziati per fase e azioni dell'utente: onboarding incompleto, carta attivata senza ricarica, saldo disponibile senza acquisti, necessità di ricarica e inattività.  Analizzare e migliorare, insieme al team Product, l'esperienza di onboarding, ricarica tramite bonifico bancario e acquisto, individuando gli ostacoli che impediscono il primo utilizzo o interrompono la continuità d'uso.  Sviluppare e testare campagne, programmi di incentivazione, loyalty e meccaniche di engagement coerenti con i diversi obiettivi delle due fasi, valutandone l'efficacia, la sostenibilità economica e la capacità di generare comportamenti duraturi.  Definire e monitorare KPI distinti per le due fasi: conversione e tempi dall'attivazione alla prima ricarica e al primo acquisto; ricariche successive, ripetizione degli acquisti, frequenza di utilizzo e retention transazionale a 30, 60 e 90 giorni. Analizzare i risultati per azienda, segmento e coorte.  Integrare dati quantitativi, interviste e ricerca sugli utenti per comprendere motivazioni, occasioni d'uso, cause di abbandono e fattori che favoriscono la costruzione di abitudini. Tradurre le evidenze in esperimenti e interventi concreti.  Lavorar

Kustomer is the AI-native customer experience platform that turns every interaction into a lasting relationship and a measurable business outcome. title: Inbound Sales Representative (Remote/Pacific Time)
description:

title: Partner Success Manager (EMEA)
description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

title: Golang Engineering Manager, Commercial Systems
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Golang Engineering Manager, who strives for accountability for the development of an internal product, who has high engineering quality standards, continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports, and who has the drive to deliver. This is an exciting opportunity to work with great people and exciting open-source solutions on innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical's growth.

The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as six engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and Golang plays an integral role in it. We are looking for software engineering managers for these teams:

The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for those interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.

The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for those interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Accountability for the design and development of an internal product
  • Leading a team of software engineers

title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure - Kafka
description:
Canonical is building a comprehensive automation suite to provide multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. The data platform team is a collaborative team that develops a managed solutions for a full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, through NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines (similar to Amazon RDS approach). 

We are facing the interesting problem of fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems and intend to deliver the world's best automation solution for delivering managed data platforms. 

We are looking for candidates from junior to senior level with interests, experience and willingness to learn around Big Data technologies, such as distributed event-stores (Kafka) and parallel computing frameworks (Spark). Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of open-source community dynamics and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organisations.

Location: This role can be filled in European, Middle East and African time zones.

What your day will look like

The data platform team is responsible for the automation of data platform operations, with the mission of managing and integrating Big Data platforms at scale. This includes ensuring fault-tolerant replication, TLS, installation, backups and much more; but also provides domain-specific expertise on the actual data system to other teams within Canonical. This role is focused on the creation and automation of infrastructure features of data platforms, not analysing and/or processing the data in them.

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high-quality, idiomatic Python code to create new features
  • Debug issues and interact with upstream communities publicly
  • Work with helpful and talented engineers including experts in many fields
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Proven hands-on experience in software development using Python
  • Proven hands-on experience in distributed systems, such as Kafka and Spark
  • Have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a similar degree
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

You might also bring a subset of experience from the followings that can help Data Platform to achieve its challenging goals and determine the level we will consider you for:

  • Experience operating and managing other data platform technologies, SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, ElasticSearch, etc), similar to DBA level expertise

title: Customer Success Internship (German speaking)
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including

title: Founding Legal Engineer
description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

title: Event Management (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Mittelständische Unternehmer erleben Beratungen meist in einer austauschbaren Eventsprache: Konferenzhotel, Standard-Catering, ein Programm, das in jedem Raum gleich aussieht. Genau dort liegt der Hebel für ein anderes Modell, über alle Anlassgrößen vom Webinar bis zur eigenen Konferenz.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen. Für dieses Netzwerk bauen wir die Event-Infrastruktur auf: Roundtables, Retreats, Salon-Formate, individuelle Mandanten-Dinner, eine laufende Webinar-Reihe, ausgewählte Messeauftritte und perspektivisch eine eigene Mittelstandskonferenz. Auch unsere internen Anlässe wie Town Hall, Sommerfest und Off-sites sollen sich anfühlen wie Vogel und nicht wie ein Standard-Firmenfest.

Du kommst aus der Premium-Hospitality, aus einem gehobenen Restaurant oder von einer Event-Marke mit hohem Anspruch und willst Formate selbst entwerfen, statt fertige Konzepte umzusetzen. Du verantwortest die Event- und Brand-Experience von Vogel, arbeitest im Growth-Team und eng mit der Geschäftsführung an ausgewählten Formaten. Nach 24 bis 36 Monaten führt der natürliche Weg in eine Lead-Rolle für Event und Brand Experience.

Deine Verantwortung

Flagship-Anlässe und individuelle Formate

  • Du entwirfst die Format-Bibliothek von Vogel, vom Salon über das kuratierte Dinner bis zum Retreat, und trägst jeden Anlass vom Konzept bis zum letzten Detail.

  • Du baust die eigene Mittelstandskonferenz mit auf: Bühne, Programm, Catering, Eingangserlebnis.

  • Du verantwortest Formate im kleinen Kreis: Mandanten-Dinner nach Branche, persönliche Termine mit Multiplikatoren, Salons mit wenigen Gästen.

title: Founder's Associate – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen. Darauf bauen wir eine Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand, organisch und durch Zukäufe, mit einem gemeinsamen Setup, in das jede neue Einheit integriert wird. about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages.

You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products.

This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor.

title: Client Service Manager
description: Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. description: ترجم الكلام هذا الى الانقليزية:  المسمى الوظيفي: مدير خدمة العملاء   الهدف الوظيفي:  إدارة وتطوير عمليات خدمة العملاء في شركة تايقو، وضمان تقديم تجربة متميزة للعملاء عبر مختلف قنوات التواصل، من خلال الإشراف على فريق خدمة العملاء، وتحسين جودة الخدمات، ومعالجة الشكاوى، بما يحقق رضا العملاء ويعزز ولاءهم للشركة.  المهام والمسؤوليات:  1. الإشراف على فريق خدمة العملاء ومتابعة أدائهم وتحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية.  2. إدارة استفسارات العملاء وشكاواهم المتعلقة بالشرائح والباقات وعمليات الشراء والتفعيل.  3. التنسيق مع شركات الاتصالات ومزودي الخدمة لمعالجة المشكلات وضمان سرعة حلها.  4. تطوير إجراءات وسياسات خدمة العملاء وتحسين تجربة العميل داخل التطبيق.  5. مراقبة مؤشرات الأداء، مثل رضا العملاء وسرعة الاستجابة ومعدل حل الشكاوى.  6. إعداد التقارير الدورية وتحليل ملاحظات العملاء وتقديم توصيات لتحسين الخدمات.  7. تدريب فريق خدمة العملاء وتطوير مهاراتهم لضمان جودة الخدمة والالتزام بالمعايير المعتمدة.  8. الإشراف على بناء أنظمة خدمة عملاء  المؤهلات والخبرات:  - درجة البكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال أو تخصص ذي صلة.  - خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في خدمة العملاء، منها سنتان في منصب إشرافي أو إداري.  - يُفضل وجود خبرة في قطاع الاتصالات أو التطبيقات الرقمية أو التجارة الإلكترونية.  - مهارات قيادية وتحليلية واتصال فعّال، مع القدرة على إدارة الشكاوى وحل المشكلات.  - إجادة استخدام أنظمة إدارة علاقات العملاء وإعداد تقارير الأداء. description: ÚNETE A LEROY MERLIN COMO LÍDER DE RELACIÓN CLIENTE TIENDA Y TRANSFORMA LA EXPERIENCIA DE CLIENTE Y EQUIPO      En Leroy Merlin, buscamos a un líder apasionado y dinámico para el puesto de Líder de Relación Cliente Tienda. title: Account Manager
description: Job Description   We are looking for an Account Manager to join our teams located in Stavanger or Bergen.  As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and growing strategic customer relationships while driving profitable business growth across assigned accounts. Det tilbyder vi • En spændende stilling med stort ansvar og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel.  • En central rolle i et internationalt modebrand med høj vækst.  • En dynamisk hverdag med korte beslutningsveje og stor indflydelse.  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.  • En uformel kultur med højt engagement, et stærkt fællesskab og plads til idéer. title: Siivouksen palvelupäällikkö Pohjanmaalle
description: RTK-Palvelu Oy on suomalainen kiinteistöpalvelujen monialayhtiö jo 50 vuoden kokemuksella. Yhtiön 3000 ammattilaista antaa asiakkailleen päivittäin mahdollisuuden keskittyä olennaiseen. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.Kannat vastuun omasta tekemisestäsi ja vastavuoroisesti annamme sinulle vapauden työskennellä itsenäisesti. title: Serviceansvarig, Ingå närhälsostation, Ingå

title: BESS Service Manager
description: Job Description: BESS Service Manager    1. Basic Job Information    Job Title : BESS O&M Service Manager   Department : Europe Service Management Dept.   Report To : Europe Service Director    Work Location : Europe (Hybrid)    Vacancy : 2      Job Attribute : Core management role, dedicated to Utility-scale and C&I ESS, responsible for full-cycle service project execution, revenue, profitability, quality and customer satisfaction.      2. Job Overview   Support to build up the service system across Europe, manage E2E after-sales service.  Front-End Sales Support: Support service sales activities; strictly control service scope, SLAs, risks and LD to ensure seamless service deliverability.  Back-End Operations: Take over Warranty and LTSA projects handover to O&M; oversee all service activities during O&M phase, present service values, ensuring O&M service quality and customer experience.  Lead to design and deploy O&M service processes and intelligent tool platforms.      3. Core Job Responsibilities    3.1 Full-Cycle Project Performance & O&M Management   Lead the service team, take full responsibility for the performance of new and existing LTSA projects, and oversee the full lifecycle O&M services after grid connection. Strictly implement contractual service standards, track core KPIs such as power station availability, system performance and fault repair timeliness, regularly deliver project performance reports and performance analysis reports, and ensure 100% compliant project performance to meet owner and grid assessment requirements.   3.2 Resource & Spare Parts System Management   Plan and implement a centralized, remote plus localized O&M model, manage own team and outsourced service providers across Europe, and standardize remote and on-site operating procedures, safety specifications and service standards.   Establish a complete mechanism for spare parts warehousing, allocation, replacement and inventory checking. Accurately predict spare parts demand, control spare parts costs and logistics efficiency, solve on-site problems such as parts shortage, replacement and rework, ensure stable operation of power stations, and effectively reduce downtime and operation losses.   3.3 Fault Disposal & Technical Optimization   Lead the disposal of major and complex faults of ESS projects, identify root causes, formulate rectification plans, preventive mechanisms and optimization strategies, and summarize standardized solutions through case review. Based on power station operating data, battery attenuation rules and system operating problems, collaborate with R&D, engineering and quality teams to promote product iteration, program upgrade, structural optimization and O&M process improvement, so as to continuously enhance the stability, safety and service life of energy storage power stations and optimize long-term project operation quality.   3.4 Customer Relationship & Satisfaction

title: Asiakasratkaisuinsinööri
description: Haemme asiakasratkaisuinsinööriä kaukolämmön palvelutuotanto- ja myyntitiimiin vastaamaan asiakaslähtöisestä ongelmanratkaisusta, asiakasyhteistyöstä ja palveluiden kehittämisestä.      Saat päävastuun palvelutuotantotiimimme lisäarvo- ja olosuhdevalvontapalveluista ja pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten niitä kehitetään, tuotteistetaan ja viedään asiakkaiden käyttöön. Koordinoit palveluihin liittyvää toimittajaverkostoa ja järjestelmiä sekä valmistelet sopimus- ja kehitystarpeita päätöksentekoon.     Sinulle on tärkeää, että asiakas saa toimivia ratkaisuja ja konkreettista hyötyä palveluistamme. Seuraat ratkaisujen toimivuutta käyttöönoton jälkeen ja tunnistat mahdollisuuksia niiden kehittämiseen ja optimointiin. Haluat ratkaista teknisiä ja taloudellisia haasteita yhteistyössä muiden kanssa ja kehittää palveluista entistä toimivampia ja kannattavampia. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä muiden porienergialaisten ja palvelutoimittajien kanssa.     Sinulla voi olla jo kokemusta energia-, LVI- tai automaatioalalta, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme oppimishalua, teknistä uteliaisuutta ja rohkeutta tarttua uusiin asioihin. Odotamme, että sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva insinöörin (AMK) tai diplomi-insinöörin koulutus. Tässä työssä tarvitset hyviä yhteistyö- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja.     Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja mielenkiintoisen tehtäväkentän kehittyvässä energiayhtiössä sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä työssäsi. Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus osittaiseen etätyöhön.     Haethan tehtävää 22.11.2026 mennessä osoitteessa www.porienergia.fi/rekry.     Yhteyshenkilö: Roni Vahamäki, kaupallinen päällikkö, puh. 044 701 2331, roni.vahamaki@porienergia.fi

Über VIA HealthTech

VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat.

Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat.

Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf.

Die Rolle

Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus.

In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht.

Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem.

  • Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen.

title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part isn't the software. Every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that's where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

At Tacto, the people who close that gap are Builders who work at the customer edge. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto, and every new one teaches us something the platform should do on its own.

 

Your Tasks

  • Prove it with their data. Show a prospect or customer what Tacto finds in their own spend, suppliers and parts, fast enough that the value is obvious.

  • Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data, until the procurement team can actually work with the result.

  • Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

  • Turn the edge into product. When you solve something twice, ship it into the platform so nobody has to solve it a third time. You're done when it drives revenue, not when the deployment is live.

  • Automate your own job. If a step can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

title: Builder
description:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

 

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

Description of the Team/Project

You will join the QPU Prototyping team, which develops and integrates the optical systems at the heart of Quandela’s quantum processors, turning advanced R&D experiments into operational hardware.

Your project will focus on developing active stabilisation and control methods to maintain QPU performance over extended periods. Working at the intersection of experimental quantum optics, instrumentation, automation and data analysis, you will help transform laboratory demonstrations into stable, reliable and operational QPU subsystems.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Characterise the physical mechanisms and environmental drifts that limit optical-system and QPU performance.
  • Develop active feedback methods to stabilise relevant parameters, such as optical phase, polarisation, spectral alignment and timing.
  • Select and integrate suitable sensors, actuators, control electronics and measurement equipment.

description:
Menschen begleiten. Wege bereiten. Zukunft gestalten.
Deine Karriere bei Klein und Partner.

Als mittelständische Kanzlei im Herzen von Köln beraten wir mit unseren über 60 engagierten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern vom weltbekannten Großkonzern über das ambitionierte Start-up bis zum Soloselbständigen eine vielschichtige Bandbreite an spannenden Mandanten. Was auf den ersten Blick wie eine klassische Steuerberatungs- und Wirtschaftsprüfungskanzlei klingen mag, ist bei genauerer Betrachtung vielleicht doch etwas mehr. Wir schaffen mit einem Berufsträgeranteil von 40 % beste Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für unser Team, profitieren täglich von einem internen Kanzlei- sowie einem zusätzlichen HR-Manager und sorgen durch unser von Wertschätzung und Vertrauen geprägtes Miteinander dafür, dass Flexibilität, Teamspirit und flache Hierarchien keine Floskeln sind. Kurz gesagt sind wir eine gute Mannschaft, die sich freuen würde, dich als neues Teammitglied in unserer Kanzlei begrüßen zu dürfen.

Unsere nachfolgende Stellenanzeige ist deshalb auch eine Bewerbung an dich und hoffentlich der Grundstein für eine gemeinsame und erfolgreiche Zukunft.

Aufgaben

Tätigkeiten.
Das passende Umfeld für deine berufliche Zukunft.

Stellst du dir manchmal die Frage, warum du eigentlich Wirtschaftsprüfer und / oder Steuerberater geworden bist? Sicherlich nicht, um dich täglich mit administrativen und repetitiven Tätigkeiten auseinandersetzen zu müssen. Stattdessen gehen wir einfach mal davon aus, dass du dich gerne mit spannenden Themen in den Bereichen Wirtschaftsprüfung und Steuerberatung beschäftigst und die Beratung von Menschen dir Spaß bringt. Falls unsere Annahme richtig ist, wirst du bei uns viel Freude haben:

Tätigkeiten in der Wirtschaftsprüfung:

  • Leitung eines kleinen Prüfungsteams und eigenverantwortliche Mandatsbetreuung
  • Prüfung von Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen
